Thank you, Peter. For everything you do to help me be elected as the next Arizona Secretary of State.

Every single donation helps grow our grassroots campaign, reach more voters, and keep extremism out of Arizona politics. And with less than 3 weeks until our primary I wanted to say thank you. This is a critical moment in our election, and your support makes it possible.

This election is a fight for our democracy, for the future of Arizona elections, and for the future of this country. All eyes will be on this race to see if we have what it takes to show extremists that they have NO place in political office.

**If we win here, we can be the blueprint for stopping extremism everywhere. And Peter, we NEED to win.**

Early voting has already started here in Arizona! But the far-right is counting on their anti-voting propaganda to keep AZ voters home so they can stack the election in their favor. But I am here to say, our democracy is on the ballot.

So, let’s show up, show out, and VOTE!

If you need more information on how to vote or your nearest polling location, please visit: **[https://www.arizona.vote/](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDONRIsSTHMr_dYnaAUv7ap99HY8DHVVCqb9NahrLFCV82BX-gPRNS-eEGvicjYPs11BuqTKE57FcWMTPHWOm4AWPXuOdYOTbM24HgKaoKH6jw-LCueWGhQkXcXGFsY7oIIBs6cfTGH9CaS_zroayuc67bBAmqMVJvHFYDQDEgg76dQ47g-vR2KlL2RZixL03IBSUI7vtZaVseFHlm7O1MnIABvHf2MFvPC8hh4ZcFHWd1Ow5UeXhB3hLZACT6a8NGQ/3no/wQl4eiyFRdawXJuLZXwVfg/h1/ofhIgDMyUx4eWrV1Nk4jmrqXwJPInlYL1AgRLTfkzyE)**

Thank you again,

Reginald

Inflation continues to take a toll on Americans, as we all feel the pain from the pump to the grocery store.

1,500 American business executives were polled. 99% believe that high inflation is hurting everyone as costs have increased and 76% plan to raise prices for customers again.

subject: You may not know the full story
body:
While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story—especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6147%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=dYlCj7yS2%2bqFqHeGP2WxXA&sysid=1)
| | | This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63490%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=K9q3QtoQJhihK4%2b8tKAuKw&sysid=1)
---
| |
Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story--especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **“The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King”** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David’s character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.
---
| | **This is why we’ve produced our online course, “The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King,” which is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy using this secure link:**

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63491%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bD93ZVTzMlEgB8CqRbVlfQ&sysid=1)** By viewing the course, you’ll learn more about the nature of God, family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you’ll learn more about what truly matters in life. **I hope you’ll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with your family and friends. The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or homeschool curriculum.**
---
| [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63492%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=qG8eJObT5Qve2Iha31x5SA&sysid=1)
---
| | Let’s learn what truly matters in life by studying **“The David Story.”**

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

Without borders and without the rule of law we have nothing.

|
Friend,

The radical left is hellbent on destroying our economy.

Even with out-of-control gas prices, unprecedented inflation, and a crashing stock market, these Woke Liberals still think they can buy their way into keeping their unlimited power over you and me.

And the worst part is...

...it might just work unless patriots like you get involved.

If we can flip seats like New Mexico's 3rd District we can take back Congress and save our great nation before it's too late.

[**Which is why I'm asking you to join me with an urgent gift of $35 or more today and join the fight to kick the Democrats out of power.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0mck2u9if7ngkcb8m16vuu7751gvg59kgroeis0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cdh60o36cjh2bs)

Let me step back and introduce myself.

My name is Alexis Martinez Johnson and I'm running for Congress because we can't afford to allow the radical left to remain in power any longer.

I was born and raised here in New Mexico, and I've spent my career making sure that American energy has been produced and jobs have kept on our shores.

Which is more than you can say for my opponent.

Teresa Leger Fernandez, who has been nothing more than a "yes woman" for Joe Biden has sat on her hands while people across New Mexico and the entire nation have suffered.

When gas shot above $5 per gallon, Fernandez was silent.

When inflation skyrocketed to all-time highs, Fernandez was silent.

When there was an extreme baby formula shortage that left families desperate for help, Fernandez was silent.

**The truth is, as long as Fernandez stays in Congress, she'll do nothing more than give Biden a big thumbs up and greenlight the Green New Deal "transition" which will make inflation and the economy even worse.**

[**Will you help me kick her out of Congress and right our economy by chipping in $5, $10, or $35 to my campaign to flip this district red and kick Democrats from Congress?**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zob61fil1fir3kfqeeslah32josgkrrjv1qjofh8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cdh60o36cjh2bs)

Friend, getting gas prices back down and endling inflation isn't complicated.

It starts with:
* Green-lighting new drilling here at home - there are thousands of untapped oil wells just here in New Mexico!
* Stop printing money we don't have - and stop telling families making $30,000 a year to buy a $60,000 electric vehicle to "save the environment."
* Ending reckless spending and handouts that drive inflation - instead we can lower taxes and rein in spending which will benefit everyone.

And that's exactly what Republicans will do once we win this district, take back Congress, and "transition" Biden OUT of the White House.

Your immediate help is going to be key.

As I said, this is the district that could determine control of Congress, which is exactly why Biden and Pelosi are spending so much campaign cash on Fernandez.

To go shot-for-shot with them, I can't waste time.

I need to get more ad campaigns up on the air and more mail into mailboxes immediately, and I need your generous financial help to do it.

[**Will you donate $5, $10, $35 today?**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zg8jedajaioph3bg4o6f8kfcmv25s5j55bflb0c8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cdh60o36cjh2bs)

Remember: Pelosi and Biden are trying to buy their way to victory in this race, so I can't afford for you to sit on the sidelines.

If we lose here, we won't just hand them control of Congress... inflation will only get worse!

I hope you know that I'll put your donation to good use right away.

November will be here before we know it, and we have no margin for error in a race as important as this one.

Onward to Victory,

body:
I’m not going to beat around the bush... we are living in a dystopian state. My team at the Center for American Liberty ha
[View this message in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zr54vbsj92ma04p2olsjdcmqrrm4mep8hoqrogvg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jksrr0s3iekr79c9l6eon9d1hmej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfcdblehrb9d5k6koe8tjleppn8pbmm5hnfc37cjj36ojkcqqj6ptgm5p36phgssrt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or0e8rmcc9gmdg6fdj2cor61cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn48d245p25oh4cdimeor2c1g64o724no)
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zklidn78tcbrgc4mqr8be9kfjimhmgh9pp8uv9ig_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cdh60o32c3h2bs) Dear Fellow Conservative, I’m not going to beat around the bush... we are living in a dystopian state. My team at the Center for American Liberty has recently uncovered evidence of powerful elected politicians colluding with Big Tech corporations like Facebook and Twitter to de-platform and silence conservatives like you and me. **In other words, we’ve caught big government using tax-payer funding to silence their political opponents.** And if someone does not immediately stand up against this, the freedoms enshrined in our Constitution will become nothing more than meaningless words on a piece of paper. That’s why we launched a lawsuit against Twitter, U.S. Senator Alex Padilla, and a handful of liberal elected officials for their state-sponsored plot to eliminate our First Amendment liberties – _and we need your help to win._ **[Will you join us in our lawsuit against Twitter and Sen. Padilla and help defend the First Amendment?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zch5ahs9hb9ed0d0lhel787eib5fglnvo38s74hg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cdh60o32c3h2bs)** Let me explain... Like millions of Americans after the 2020 presidential election, conservative activist Rogan O’Handley took to Twitter to express his concerns about the dubious election procedures and skepticism of the results. [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zti2vtq3otdae8gnsep0do4dkiq5s6to7cq9188o_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cdh60o32c3h2bs) [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z0hb179nklgboc92a0sckqq2asfs17m47n4ca9l8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cdh60o32c3h2bs) [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z266sg88l1q8gl1jgt77prntv2fjdd7rdcgatk60_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cdh60o32c3h2bs) Shortly after the election, many of Rogan's tweets were removed by Twitter and his account was permanently suspended for “violating the government’s rules about election integrity.” _Hopefully, I don’t need to explain to you that censoring or de-platforming ANY American for their political beliefs or opinions is a gross violation of the First Amendment._ But it gets much worse... When Rogan tried to figure out why he was censored, he found that bureaucrats working for then-California Secretary of State, Alex Padilla, had explicitly instructed officials at Twitter to silence him. You see, Alex Padilla was being considered to fill Kamala Harris’ vacated seat in the U.S. Senate – and he was afraid that Rogan’s tweets would hurt his image and chances of being appointed. **So, the office of Alex Padilla immediately instructed his press secretary to contact Twitter and shut Rogan up.** **From:** California Secretary of State Communications Department **To:** Twitter **Date:** Tuesday, November 17th, 2020 at 12:31 PM Hi, We wanted to flag this Twitter post: [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zpdvgdamfbg7in9aa5vt0mcqr85h4tmc57uq2k8o_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cdh60o32c3h2bs) From user @DC_Draino. In this post user claims California of being a culprit of voter fraud, and ignores the fact that we do audit votes. This is a blatant disregard to how our voting process works and creates disinformation and distrust among the general public. Twitter then flagged the post as misinformation, deleted it, and -- a few weeks later -- permanently banned Rogan from the their site. [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zipcbkddlsalla1mo2luokt9kdudl8fha0kvfo2g_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cdh60o32c3h2bs) That’s why my team and I at the Center for America Liberty are suing Twitter, now-Senator Alex Padilla, California Secretary of State Shirly Weber, and a handful of other liberals for their involvement in this blatant assault on the First Amendment. But the only way we can take on the deep pockets and deep connections of these tyrants is with the help of patriotic Americans like you. [**Will you help us fund this critical lawsuit by sending a generous, tax-deductible contribution of just $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty today?**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zgvdpt7bv62ebb5ofq1m20t3mbqben8n0igblhl0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cdh60o32c3h2bs) My name is Harmeet Dhillon. Two years ago, I founded the Center for American Liberty with the purpose of protecting our First Amendment freedoms and civil liberties from being destroyed by today’s left. We’ve taken on Governor Gavin Newsom in California when he unconstitutionally shut down small businesses, banned people from going to church, and kept millions of children locked up in their homes—out of school—during the pandemic. We’ve taken on Antifa for viciously assaulting and nearly killing journalist Ando Ngo who exposed Antifa’s vile, anarchic plot to destroy the United States and turn it into a socialist utopia. **And now, we’re taking on Twitter, Sen. Alex Padilla, and others for colluding to eliminate Rogan O’Handley’s freedom of speech.** But as a non-profit organization, everything we do to defend our civil liberties is with the generous help of like-minded conservative patriots like you. And this massive lawsuit is expected to cost us over $1,000,000. _After all, we are taking a multi-billion-dollar company, the state of California, and a handful of well-connected politicians._ [**So, can I count on you to help us stand up to Twitter and Senator Alex Padilla by making a tax-deductible contribution of $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty today?**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zhgl0pkgcv4ca12svlgh1p206rubdq22gmaiu7l0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cdh60o32c3h2bs) I’m not exaggerating when I say that this is the legal battle that will define our generation – and the future of our country. Will we sit back and allow elitist politicians, billion-dollar corporations, and faceless government agencies to continue to trample our constitutional freedoms? Or will we prove that WE, the American people, are still in control of our own lives? [**Please join us in this critical fight to defend the First Amendment by contributing $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty today.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zsusk5tvu00bqlpsc401uopt094ptgl6ktaeoh7g_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cdh60o32c3h2bs) Sincerely, Harmeet K. Dhillon P.S. For four years, leftist politicians and mainstream media figures would not let go of the bogus and unproven accusation that President Trump colluded with Russia to “steal” the 2016 election. But now that there is clear evidence that a California elected official colluded with big tech to censor conservatives who wanted to comment on the 2020 election those same leftists are dead-silent. I am absolutely fed up with left’s hypocrisy, double-standards, and blatantly unconstitutional behavior. [**That’s why I’m urgently asking you to contribute $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty to help us fund our lawsuit against Twitter and Senator Alex Padilla. **](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zh8pkt39sv5lo4m0v8cuupesrouk9ficu4lvnj6g_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cdh60o32c3h2bs) [**DONATE**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2ztd56pj30og13eq5cc7hdimgrnb5kcj35lbik5do_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cdh60o32c3h2bs) [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zc8vmq2h4r7gr0dshf2oimhndckckgj2smhqu548_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cdh60o32c3h2bs) [Please consider supporting our efforts to defend our Constitution with a donation today.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zghrrj14r860k88mg1ujqh9s745bhtdhvcu94e90_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cdh60o32c3h2bs) The Center For American Liberty is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization created to fight against growing anti-free-speech and anti-civil liberties trends.

name: Grace Jo
subject: I escaped from North Korea, and this is my story
body:
When you hear about North Korea, you think of socialism, dictatorship, food shortages, and poor living conditions. But little is told about what happens to the citizens. What happened to me. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9452%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=Wc5Xp9c9qAtTu%2fxQcQf0kQ&sysid=1)
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c37413%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=JpRnjqGGipctDa%2bbW0xz2A&sysid=1)
Hello Friend,

When you hear about North Korea, you think of socialism, dictatorship, food shortages, and poor living conditions.

But little is told about what happens to the citizens. What happened to me.

My name is Grace Jo. I escaped North Korea and the horrors of socialism.

Most Americans today don’t understand what socialism does to you. How it steals your humanity-starves your soul, your mind, your stomach of all that freedom provides.

_That’s why I want to tell my story to students across America_.

**Young Voice’s Dissident Project brings survivors of tyrannical socialist countries to high schools around the United States to tell their stories.**

We are countering the mainstream narratives about how peaceful and successful socialism can be. Too many young people are taught to believe the United States is an evil, oppressive country and that capitalism is a failure.

[_**Friend, can you help sponsor a student for just $15, so they can hear my story --the story of a survivor? Click here to donate $15, $45, $90, or any amount >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c37414%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=S7PzuNqcImmXKSFllNdRwQ&sysid=1)

I am starting to see more and more similarities between North Korea and America.

College students and others now censor themselves to avoid public backlash over the tiniest of things.

This reminds me of how in North Korea, everyone must censor themselves because if they’re caught saying anything negative about the regime, they could be thrown in jail or even executed. While no one is getting executed in the United States, people are self-censoring, or else they get kicked out of prestigious organizations or canceled by online mobs.

[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c37413%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=JpRnjqGGipctDa%2bbW0xz2A&sysid=1)

**This is my story:**

[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c37413%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=JpRnjqGGipctDa%2bbW0xz2A&sysid=1)

During the 90s, North Korea suffered one of the world’s worst famines.

During that time, I only ate about 1 meal a week--a little rice, maybe some vegetables. Sometimes even mice that we caught.

In 1998, my grandmother and younger brothers all passed away because of starvation. The food situation was very bad. My younger brother and I were starved for 10 days straight. We only drank cold water because there was no food we could find.

My father was tortured and starved to death, he passed away when North Korean agents transferred him from a detention center to a jail, and his “crime” was that he left his country in search of food for his family.

That was when my mother, sister, and I first escaped, and it turned into the first of many, as we were caught, repatriated, and escaped again.

Some of my family escaped, but most were murdered by the regime.

This is just a small part of my story, Friend.

Coming to America changed my life.

**In North Korea, we are taught to avoid Americans. If we see them, we should try to kill them because they are our enemies.**

But I’ve learned that that isn’t true. Americans are kind, generous, and caring.

That’s why I’m asking for your support, Friend. Can you help sponsor the Dissident Program, so I can share my story? **Click any button to send your donation.**

no doubt in my mind that our nation's citizens are in need of

why I'm sending you this email today.

| Peter,

As Lt. Governor and as a lifelong Vermonter, I’ve seen firsthand how the pandemic has amplified the challenges already facing our small, rural state. From affordable quality child care to affordable housing and good paying jobs, I’m committed to working hard to bring real solutions to working families across Vermont, that’s why I’m running for Congress.

I was born and raised on a family farm in Newbury, where I was taught to work hard and stand up for what’s right. I took that to heart which is why I’ve dedicated my life to public service and human rights. I’m proud of our state and so much of what we stand for.

Our leadership on climate action, reproductive justice and voting rights can be a model for the nation. We need Vermont’s values in Washington and our values will guide my work as Vermont’s Congresswoman.

We’ve accomplished a lot together already during my time as Lt. Governor, and now our work continues.

**As we grow this campaign, we want all of you, and _every_ Vermonter, off the sidelines and on our team.**

[Please, take a moment to complete our survey and make your voice heard.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47713516/355359793/-1464036493?contactdata=Rm%2BX7LTaSLQ4lTrz1csCCKlosa1zbMU%2BGp5SqG8rlSY9RUwXzjq9CgVlyZlyb5AzvncL0lQQX9Hk70JbQjHrbwQHP1%2FhoeAeu2Vo0qlcrEvsX3Etm%2FQCE8Pc0AzKzveA&source=MG_EM_WL_NTL_211215_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYWVhMzkwZS1lOTAxLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=r9W1Tsp1EXxCttSK3pVJrCuknD3I1E1bmeQEqlAsGlQ=&emci=e69dd494-c65d-ec11-94f6-0050f2e65e9b&emdi=2aea390e-e901-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=43402276)

I'm proud to be featured in the latest issue of Al Dia, and I want to make sure supporters, like you, have a chance to read more about my story as a first generation immigrant running for Congress in PA-10. To check out the full article, click here. [https://aldianews.com/en/politics/women-politics/latina-rep-pa?emci=a550837b-dc01-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=]
We have a chance to make history in this election. If I am successful in defeating Scott Perry in November, I will become the first Latina ever elected to Congress from Pennsylvania.
DONATE $25, $50, $100, $250 OR MORE TO HELP US MAKE HISTORY - CLICK HERE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email]
I've dedicated my career as an attorney, and in politics, to giving a voice to those who had none.
Why? Because I believe that America is for all of us, and I believe our country is stronger and more vibrant when everyone has access to the opportunity to realize the dreams they have for themselves and their families.
I am proof that the American Dream can still be a reality, and I believe we have to fight to protect it!
This election isn't just about me, it's about all of us, and winning in November is going to take all of us.
As one of our loyal supporters, I hope you'll enjoy learning more about me from this article. I'm grateful to have you on our team, and I'm asking for your help with a donation to our campaign today.

name: Ron DeSantis
subject: Woke Nanny-State
body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the link below, or copy and paste it into your browser's address window.
https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=7a91fe66a471adb127351342d2789b622bc88d3a13203ab17385d66e2bbf924bcb0d931c71bf9cabba8c8ce240a66ffe113d186150f2931a43015df8fbb1c0a0a5abd48546f36042d71a3cb7defde698

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=0f1cfb73e93292c8375f67c68a417cc6f8f61b351a399b4bca67cfb778ea7dc344f4edd8757c0d37a9690240a5ceab91a842f665f0a0e5c3

Peter,

Over the past three years, we have been called to make choices and answer questions we did not expect.

Questions about how, in a world that seemed frightening and different, we were going to raise our kids, continue to put food on the table, and care for our communities?

And questions that feel further out now like, how does our government interact with its citizenry in a time of crisis?

How is our government — one of the people, by the people, for the people — meant to protect life, but not stifle liberty?

In crisis, do we foster freedom? Or do we force our citizens down?

Well, over the past three years I believe we have had the truth revealed about those two vastly different approaches. Not in an academic textbook or in a theoretical debate, but in the harsh reality of governing during COVID. You could not find two more starkly different examples than the free state of Florida and the woke tyranny of Gavin Newsom’s California.

It isn't hard to understand why the Governor of California wants to talk about Florida. It's part of the one topic he tries to focus on: Anything but California.

Let's take a look at the record of the “liberal elite” in California:
1.
They locked their kids out of public schools at the behest of the teachers’ unions.
2.
They forced small businesses to close with many never to re-open again.
3.
They hobbled law enforcement and allowed drugs and crime to destroy their cities.
Everything on that list is a tragedy, and it’s only made worse by the disregard and disrespect shown by leaders like Gavin Newsom. The idea of locking down your citizens and then darting off to the fanciest restaurant in the state to rub their noses in it.

It's wrong, it’s disgusting, and it's no surprise that every day driving around Florida I see more and more California license plates as a result.

In Florida, we didn't bludgeon our people with government mandates; we lifted people up — protecting their jobs, their businesses, and their kids’ education.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=0f1cfb73e93292c86a588217bc45605e5fad6278e4aa7919a12c70199ebf854de2fe2e3c0c0058a16ee1a4b5a957dbd2a99356cba71457b1
>>">Help us keep Florida free in November >>>

We didn't lock business owners out of their livelihoods and we didn't lock people out of their jobs.

In Florida we didn't turn a blind eye to crime and drugs, we put criminals behind bars, and we kept our streets safe.

Gavin Newsom doesn't want to talk about California, and I don't blame him. But the reality is, there are plenty of woke liberal billionaires on Gavin Newsom’s speed dial who do not want to see individual freedom succeed. They don't want to see it succeed in Florida or anywhere else.

Because if it succeeds, it shows everyone that the top down nanny-state tyranny of California is avoidable — Free people making their own decisions are better off than a locked down citizenry dictated to by elitists.

That's why I need your help. Gavin Newsom, funded by Hollywood liberals, Big Tech billionaires, and who knows who else is running ads in Florida. I need your help to fight back.On our side are free people who care to stay that way. On their side is everyone who thinks they know better.

Show them that we intend to stay free:
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=0f1cfb73e93292c86a588217bc45605e5fad6278e4aa7919a12c70199ebf854de2fe2e3c0c0058a16ee1a4b5a957dbd2a99356cba71457b1
Make a donation right now to help us fight back. You can use this
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=0f1cfb73e93292c8375f67c68a417cc6f8f61b351a399b4bca67cfb778ea7dc344f4edd8757c0d37a9690240a5ceab91a842f665f0a0e5c3
secure link .

Sincerely,
Ron DeSantis

| Raleigh, N.C. - Sen. Chuck Edwards (R-Henderson) released the following statement on Gov. Roy Cooper's veto of [Senate Bill 101](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001FYL_R3HGxy2rx7H1LqEGC5xxzbUI62mqmhATXo_WhrLHIecACZh7FmofDVF58Q-414_iYfA7-FRX2i1pylEWR0r4B5lxoDu1plF8AWHeEdwmLKASbZKUPk4LxLPtTAhyWhYGS55STLudf_qAFETZ7miJMDjKujnD2aZCN0NqwV4wWwXAZWcwJNl5G7Pn1iQ4n14fhmA2TM0gFGxUSM6AYxkIhtTKoF__6QwMEnj4xTsX-KQgDp8jr1vWszjBVGlDx0cwsk2rpzQydyiQeNhhCV74A5PJrql-Wu8NWWo78flnFM0S9b6lAtqkfhdHp_0voXgiFpCo8tFnOsott6s1Dk5Qpqu_Xl3ShaD4U0ETto22Q-EA_C73BsaewJK8yFALzxc1RIDstD5N843ugVks-xeRKiLxVaZ91moqas8IFYU5tIpv_a_oZM0_DLx901oqA3YO1_ddrM9KvUsUtHVwr-Ud_T7ALi6fzzXO_rha0vkW8b6sifeiJ-4c35g0GAhbszDtHTF1DRzlFC4M4dVWcMcnh8b8IyZGtUgUJq8dFPUEGrBqwy7QTpjpjzCwmFqomn1Ptr4Z7eOWkari-EEB2mDzybZQfXAm_n9xoFTxhE_UYZB8_OM86j4MYjGPyVypca3I3O32FPDBEEFqh2q4B-sjG0tXTG35uoUhKmRRoKTkCO5OJoZro2Y08pSZJxz9VNu9-IAYZXYt3usYui7x3Ylb5hj1MSGMwvK4Wa0-zxD4Nr-WmmjjXpAum-y13NztBXzJRqrPv0_sfSzJsGqPKiyFQdC63zOAwK4419DrOdVyvXAIveC1d6XbsOTk1GCAKoxmqkAPFRKMurC1EylVk8pz5BDJP-jSmOxGmZQ2VVimmhoOoR4h1NsVR7Fe_fc0ku8lL0SrpsmdzFmeyxAdylbDAikj95EGdf_iquCEubuJ-M5LRRU-naUwySmoIQXqG4r2-0exqhO_hKErLb8_O1GAIjeO46lj1B_aI-PQLtS6EIjI8cNsF9LW_11ccvLV_Cte550jcnWCy8jRqXv_7EF0hGNT4DJUMbTRstq3l9fWi8tLySVH__pl1gGnj-Sa6kLI0A8CZZHVAqUEcCxuSFi7625_S6Tm1iQACTTHhhctng-UwbsEBDFKaWt1qtr-wKpGxHu4PotqrGr5EKiot_CFtqUqVCv0&c=ZXZgL4OrLNhFjyPHncTMt0fUapdVr5-jGBKVm0x6Bd1UIZSyDCSwtg==&ch=kC7X53ccUv0IvYAoeM-yL2U2ZPfm3JxHE-KaB4rcr6XFEZwr8aECxw==), which would require North Carolina sheriffs to cooperate with federal immigration authorities when dealing with suspected illegal immigrants already in jail for committing a violent crime: "With the stroke of his pen, Gov. Cooper just gave Sanctuary Sheriffs permission to shield an illegal immigrant who rapes or murders a North Carolinian. body:
Peter,

I hate weak Republican sellouts.

You and I cannot afford anymore Liz Cheneys, Mitt Romneys, or Adam Kinzingers.

_One of my primary opponents is a pro-amnesty RINO_.

Support for amnesty is the centerpiece of Joe Biden's open borders agenda and creates a magnet attracting an illegal alien invasion.

I fought with President Trump to build 500 miles of border wall.

**And if I win re-election, I will vote for Speaker Donald Trump to finish the border wall, end the illegal alien invasion, and impeach Joe Biden.** [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60461064:sQnS4yhMN:m:1:2365227053:65122BD9EA05639A7670500EB18E9CFC:r) **But I need your help to get the message out.**

My campaign _needs to raise $37,578_ to keep this ad running.

**[That's why I hope you will chip in a contribution of $10, $25, or $50 so my campaign can continue to spread the America First message](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60461064:sQnS4yhMN:m:1:2365227053:65122BD9EA05639A7670500EB18E9CFC:r).** [**STAND WITH MATT GAETZ
CHIP IN TODAY**](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60461064:sQnS4yhMN:m:1:2365227053:65122BD9EA05639A7670500EB18E9CFC:r) **Amnesty invites invasion.**

I know this truth, and that's why I served as President Trump's strongest ally in Congress when the Trump administration created the most secure border in American history.

But Joe Biden rolled out a red carpet for millions of illegal aliens to pour into the country.

Now my message is simple.

__Round them up and deport them_._

If I win re-election, I plan to vote for Donald Trump as Speaker of the House and continue to fight for the America First secure borders agenda.

**That's why I need your help to keep my campaign's new ad running on TV and online.**

**[So please chip in a contribution of $10, $25, $50, $250, $500, $1,000, or $2,900, so I can let every Trump supporter in my district know I am the only candidate in this race that will finish the wall, stop the illegal alien invasion and impeach Joe Biden](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60461064:sQnS4yhMN:m:1:2365227053:65122BD9EA05639A7670500EB18E9CFC:r).** [**JOIN THE FIGHT

If I win re-election, I plan to vote for Donald Trump as Speaker of the House and continue to fight for the America First secure borders agenda. That's why I need your help to keep my campaign's new ad running on TV and online. . Matt Gaetz Congresman (R-FL) Paid for by Friends of Matt Gaetz. body:

If you thought Pelosi and the Democrats wouldn't exploit the shooting in Illinois to further their gun confiscation schemes, boy you're sorely mistaken. "Assault Weapons Ban?" Yup. Banning High-Capacity Magazines? Absolutely. National Gun Registry? 100% Our backs are against the wall. Kamala Harris called for a so-called assault weapon ban and Nancy Pelosi is acting on her demands. It won't be long before every other Democrat and squishy RINO joins her call. **[That's why we URGENTLY need your $25, $50, or $100 contribution to stop Pelosi and the gun-grabbers in Congress from destroying our Second Amendment rights.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60781786:JiZTZgoNu:m:1:3253819041:A7F00CF14CA06A9D62F66F849BC13AEB:r "That’s why we URGENTLY need your $25,

We can't rest for a second. Pelosi is planning to introduce the so-called assault weapons ban this month and you saw how fast she and her Leftist allies passed the last gun control measure; they have the momentum to get it done this Summer. [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60781786:JiZTZgoNu:m:1:3253819041:A7F00CF14CA06A9D62F66F849BC13AEB:r "The American Firearms Association")**This new bill would make it a felony to buy over 200 rifles and shotguns --everything from an AR-15 to an MPX and anything in-between.** It would also ban "high-capacity" magazines... including magazines that hold 10 rounds! We can't let this happen! **[But if we're going to have any chance to stop Pelosi's horrible "assault weapons ban," we'll need champions of the Second Amendment like you to step up and contribute $50, $100, or $250 today.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60781786:JiZTZgoNu:m:1:3253819041:A7F00CF14CA06A9D62F66F849BC13AEB:r "But if we’re going to have any chance to stop
Pelosi’s horrible “assault weapons ban,” we’ll need champions of the Second Amendment like you to step up and contribute $50,
$100, or $250 today.")** The American Firearms Association is here to fight for your Second Amendment rights. While other organizations are flapping in the wind, AFA is fighting in the trenches to protect your right to bear arms, and our track record of protecting the 2A and promoting Constitutional Carry in over a dozen states speaks for itself. [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60781786:JiZTZgoNu:m:1:3253819041:A7F00CF14CA06A9D62F66F849BC13AEB:r "Headline")**We 're unapologetically Pro-Second Amendment. And we'll never wave the white flag.** But right now, we are waving the red flag of danger. The rights bestowed upon us by our Founding Fathers are under threat of being gutted. Don't think for a moment that you're safe because you already own all the guns you want and that this ban won't affect you. Because the laws on the books are never enough for these gun-grabbers. Just look at the Highland Park shooter and the Chicago gun violence over Independence Day Weekend. Everything Biden and Pelosi got passed last month was already in place in Illinois... and it didn't stop the violence. So now they're going to demand even more laws. Listen, they don't care that only law-abiding citizens are being harmed. They just want any excuse to take away your guns and they won't stop until they have them all! **[That's why it's vital you join us by contributing $100, $500, or $1,000 today to help us fight off Pelosi's "assault weapons ban" once and for all.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60781786:JiZTZgoNu:m:1:3253819041:A7F00CF14CA06A9D62F66F849BC13AEB:r "That’s why it’s
vital you join us by contributing $100, $500, or $1,000 today to help us fight off Pelosi’s “assault weapons ban” once and for all.")** Don't delay. The only thing that can stop them is freedom-loving Americans like you who are ready to join us and fight back to protect our Second Amendment rights from being gutted. **[Join us today!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60781786:JiZTZgoNu:m:1:3253819041:A7F00CF14CA06A9D62F66F849BC13AEB:r "Join us today!")** For America,

Chris Dorr
President, American Firearms Association | | [PROTECT THE 2A!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60781786:JiZTZgoNu:m:1:3253819041:A7F00CF14CA06A9D62F66F849BC13AEB:r "PROTECT THE 2A!")

**How do we fix the Supreme Court?**

**RESPONDENT: dpwillis67@gmail.com**

---
The Supreme Court has used its recent term to restrict women's rights, make our communities less safe, and set back policies to protect our environment.

Just in the last month, the court has:
* Gutted states’ ability to implement common-sense gun reforms
* Blurred the line of separation between church and state
* Overturned _Roe v. Wade_ and let states implement harsh abortion bans that leave zero exception for life of the mother, rape, or incest
* Severely limited the EPA's ability to regulate greenhouse gasses that cause climate change

And it's only going to get worse from here on out. The decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , for example, has the potential to uproot other issues concerning the constitutional right to privacy — such as same-sex marriage, access to contraceptives, or any number of rights that we hold dear. And in the next term, we could see this court further dismantle the Voting Rights Act.

To mitigate the immediate damage from this court's recent rulings, LBR is focused right now on solutions in Congress – including legislation that codifies the right to an abortion. But we also have to fundamentally re-evaluate how the Supreme Court operates in relation to our legislature. **When an unelected group of extreme judges can undo decades of precedent and uproot people's fundamental rights — in clear defiance of the popular will — something needs to change.**

So we want to hear from you. **[Can you take a minute to fill out our survey and tell LBR your thoughts on how we can fix the Supreme Court?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47716636/355372076/882507610?ms=em_pet_220711surv_n_scotus_actives_12_ng_n_l2&refcode=em_pet_220711surv_n_scotus_actives_12_ng_n_l2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOTA1NzM1NC1lYzAxLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IlDmzc8xIMEV0yufh5M8xT3MOGEgau8oxAqcotjzYaQ=&emci=ae62d210-5e01-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=19057354-ec01-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=11913588)**

---
It’s important to remember how we got here. This court's current right-wing majority owes itself to dirty tricks and unprecedented actions by Republicans that defied American voters.

In 2016, Mitch McConnell held up the nomination of Merrick Garland for nearly _one year_ , all to deny President Obama the pick on the court that he deserved. And just mere _days_ before the 2020 election, Donald Trump rushed to appoint Amy Coney Barrett to replace the late Ruth Bader Ginsburg. **Quite frankly, it's an insult to the foundations of our country that a third of this court was appointed by a President who routinely broke the law and tried to instigate a coup.**

LBR is prepared to work tirelessly to protect our rights and strengthen our democracy, but she can’t do this alone. This is why your voice is so important. [**Please fill out our survey here →**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47716639/355372078/882507610?ms=em_pet_220711surv_n_scotus_actives_12_ng_n_l3&refcode=em_pet_220711surv_n_scotus_actives_12_ng_n_l3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOTA1NzM1NC1lYzAxLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IlDmzc8xIMEV0yufh5M8xT3MOGEgau8oxAqcotjzYaQ=&emci=ae62d210-5e01-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=19057354-ec01-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=11913588)

Thank you,

Team LBR

He’s a champion for economic diversification, gun safety, the environment, and more. _** **_You’re receiving this email because you have supported Democrats like Pat in the past. Supporters like you help us build the people-powered movement needed to elect a true representative of Hawai'i to Congress. We hope you stick around, but if you’d like to unsubscribe, you may do so at any time at the bottom of this email._**

| | Aloha friends, My name is Patrick Pihana Branco, and I’m running to represent Hawaiʻi’s 2nd Congressional District in Congress. **Together, we can build a future that belongs to all of us. If you support good-paying jobs, reproductive freedom, gun safety reform, universal healthcare, and preserving Hawaiʻi’s unique traditions and way of life, I’m humbly asking you to endorse my campaign today >>**
---
| [Endorse](https://patrickbranco.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=de935e592040886098d776676&id=1a741d08b1&e=f86b831aa4 "Endorse")
---
| I’ve dedicated my life to serving Hawaiʻi and our country. Born and raised in Kailua, I grew up in a multigenerational household with my parents, tūtū, grandpa, aunts, uncles, and a whole lot of cousins. In the summers, my cousins and I were sent to Kurtistown to help out on my great-grandpa’s farm. We’d work with the pigs in the morning, and if we did a good job, we’d get to go to Four Miles Beach as a reward in the afternoon. My parents worked multiple jobs to provide for my brother and I, and it’s because of their hard work and sacrifice that I had the opportunity to attend the Kamehameha Schools, go to college and graduate school on full merit scholarships, and ultimately join the U.S. Foreign Service as a Diplomat. After promoting American values in some of the most volatile regions in the world, such as Pakistan, Colombia, and Venezuela, I returned home to run to represent my hometown in the Hawaiʻi State Legislature.
---
| [ ](https://patrickbranco.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=de935e592040886098d776676&id=cd42b2bf5f&e=f86b831aa4)
---
_My mom, me, and my tūtū making kūpuna kits in March, 2020_
| At the start of the pandemic, I put my crisis management skills to work to keep our community safe. My tūtū, mom, and I made 500 kūpuna kits filled with gloves, hand sanitizer, a can of soup, apple sauce, and a roll of toilet paper to help our kūpuna get by. My ʻohana and I also sewed over 4,000 masks that we gave away to community members in need for free. I witnessed my neighbors, friends, and family get priced out of Hawaiʻi and forced to move to the continent due to skyrocketing housing prices, rising healthcare costs, and growing inequality. I saw the pain of aunties and uncles losing their jobs and their children leaving Hawaiʻi. **My commitment to preserving our culture, history, and community runs deep.** That’s why I am fighting for a government that invests in good-paying jobs, a world-class education for our keiki, high-quality hospitals, infrastructure, and programs that support local communities here in Hawaiʻi. But it’s going to take a broad coalition of friends, neighbors, and communities to win, just like how it took a village to make my life story possible. **Right now, we’re gearing up for the August 13 primary election in order to become the Democratic nominee on the general election ballot in November.** **[I need you in this fight, friend. If you’re with us, join our grassroots movement today by endorsing my campaign for Congress>>](https://patrickbranco.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=de935e592040886098d776676&id=c66cfcfe0f&e=f86b831aa4)**
---
| [Endorse Our Movement](https://patrickbranco.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=de935e592040886098d776676&id=df3f3be76a&e=f86b831aa4 "Endorse Our Movement")
---
| Hawaiʻi residents deserve representation and leaders who truly understand our struggles. With you by my side, we will deliver meaningful results for working families across HI-02 and bring our collective fight to Congress. Thank you for having my back. — Pat

For me, pro-life isn’t just a slogan. It’s my life’s work. It’s why I celebrate the recent Supreme Court decision overturning Roe v. Wade, and it’s why I’m supporting the Value Them Both Amendment on the ballot in Kansas next month. If you live in Kansas, I hope you’ll join me in voting for this pivotal constitutional amendment. Hoy les escribo desde Albuquerque, donde nos reunimos con los residentes de South Valley para dar nuestro mensaje de esperanza, prosperidad y cambio en el Congreso en esta histórica y hermosa comunidad de Albuquerque. | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47727297/355402476/-1370483914?refcode=fl_email_na_20220712spanish_gv_od30s_xx_img1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzAxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YzZmYjZiMy1mNzAxLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=p7BSYcnb7Fk09Us3YCjdB2PRt3af_6y5tE7DoyAPjUk=)

Estoy muy orgulloso de la campaña que estamos realizando y de qué estamos hablando a los votantes de este gran distrito para obtener el apoyo de nuestras comunidades rurales, nativas y urbanas. Tomará el esfuerzo de todos para sacar a Yvette Herrell del Congreso y elegir a un líder que escuche, un líder audaz que rechaza la influencia de Wall Street, los intereses especiales y luche solo por los trabajadores y familias de Nuevo México. Yo sere ese lider.
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47727299/355402477/-1370483914?refcode=fl_email_na_20220712spanish_gv_od30s_xx_img2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzAxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YzZmYjZiMy1mNzAxLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=p7BSYcnb7Fk09Us3YCjdB2PRt3af_6y5tE7DoyAPjUk=)
---
Es por eso que recientemente hicimos paradas en Hillsboro, Las Cruces, Isleta Pueblo, Albuquerque y Deming, donde nos reunimos con líderes locales y están comprometidos a trabajar juntos por un futuro mejor para nuestras familias.
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47727301/355402478/-1370483914?refcode=fl_email_na_20220712spanish_gv_od30s_xx_img3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzAxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YzZmYjZiMy1mNzAxLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=p7BSYcnb7Fk09Us3YCjdB2PRt3af_6y5tE7DoyAPjUk=)
---
Hay mucho que aún podemos perder al cabo de las próximas elecciones, y cuando hablo con ustedes, los escucho alto y claro. Muchos nuevo mexicanos están luchando para prosperar y muchos de nuestros derechos están en peligro. Es por eso que me comprometo firmemente a luchar por estos cambios cuando me elijan para el Congreso:
* Restaurar el derecho de las mujeres a tomar sus propias decisiones de salud reproductiva
* Reducir el costo de los alimentos, el gas y la vivienda
* Proteger nuestro medio ambiente y hacer responsable por contaminación a las empresas de petróleo y gas
* Proporcionar un camino permanente hacia la ciudadanía para los beneficiarios de DACA y los estadounidenses indocumentados
* Ayudar a resolver los complejos problemas de agua de nuestro estado y protegiendo los trabajadores y las tradiciones agrícolas
* Hacer que la educación, la atención médica y el cuidado infantil sean asequibles para todos los nuevo mexicanos
* Proteger nuestra democracia y nuestros derechos de votar

... y mucho más.
Yvette Herrell no es solo un impedimento para el progreso, vota activamente en contra de nuestros mejores intereses y es leal sólo a Donald Trump y a los más ricos de este país.
Continuaré luchando por nuestra gente y les pido que se unan a mí y me ayuden de cualquier manera que puedan: ofreciéndose como voluntario, haciendo una donación y corriendo la voz.
Al servicio de usted y su comunidad,
Gabe Vásquez

It’s going to take all of us to get Yvette Herrell out of Congress and elect a leader who cares — a bold leader who will stand up to Wall Street, special interests, and fight for working New Mexicans.
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47727304/355402481/-1370483914?refcode=fl_email_na_20220712spanish_gv_od30s_xx_img2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzAxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YzZmYjZiMy1mNzAxLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=p7BSYcnb7Fk09Us3YCjdB2PRt3af_6y5tE7DoyAPjUk=)

That’s why we recently made stops in Hillsboro, Las Cruces, Isleta Pueblo, Albuquerque, and Deming, where we met with local leaders who are on #TeamVasquez and are committed to working together for a better future for our families.
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47727305/355402482/-1370483914?refcode=fl_email_na_20220712spanish_gv_od30s_xx_img3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzAxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YzZmYjZiMy1mNzAxLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=p7BSYcnb7Fk09Us3YCjdB2PRt3af_6y5tE7DoyAPjUk=)

There is so much at stake in the upcoming election, and I hear you loud and clear. Many New Mexicans are struggling, and many of our rights are at stake. That’s why I strongly commit to fighting for change when you elect me to Congress:
* Restoring women’s rights to make their own reproductive healthcare decisions
* Lowering the cost of groceries, gas, and housing
* Protecting our environment and holding oil and gas companies accountable
* Providing a permanent pathway to citizenship to DACA recipients and undocumented Americans
* Helping to solve our state’s complex water issues and protecting agricultural traditions
* Making education, healthcare, and child care affordable for every New Mexican
* Protecting our voting rights at the ballot box

... and more.
Yvette Herrell is not just an impediment to progress, she actively votes against our best interests and is loyal only to Donald Trump and the wealthiest in this country.
I will continue to fight for the people of our district and I ask you to join me and help any way you can — by volunteering, making a donation, and spreading the word.
In service to you and your community,
Gabe Vasquez

body:
Peter, I asked you to step up at the last second and you did! Your support never goes unnoticed. I want you know how much I truly value you being part of this team and all you do for our campaign.

We witnessed the atrocities that the GOP did under Trump, and are still die-hard to make a reality if they take control of Congress in November – banning abortion across the nation, stripping Americans of their healthcare, giving major tax cuts to the wealthiest on the backs of the hardest working... Trump and his GOP cronies in Washington have made it loud and clear: they do NOT care about 99% of our families and our needs.

This is exactly why I take your support to heart every day. Your support helps us keep our Democratic majority in the House and I pray expand it in the Senate this fall. I need you to continue being part of Gwen Nation today and every day. Your power is what has and will keep making the difference. Your power is what creates progress for our families and our nation.

You are the wind beneath my wings, and I will forever be grateful for you and all you do.

-Gwen Moore

name: Maggie Hassan
subject: My daughter is now less free than I was at her age.
body:
I am the third in a line of four women named Margaret. My grandmother, Margaret Cooke Byers, was born in 1897 and turned 22 on the day that Congress passed the 19th Amendment, which allowed women to vote.
My mother, Peggy Byers Wood, saw women achieve the right to control their own bodies, finances, and futures with the Roe decision. I am the third Margaret, becoming the second woman in the history of America to be elected both Governor and Senator.
Over the course of my grandmother's, my mother's, and my lifetime, women have made tremendous progress towards achieving their rights as full and equal citizens in our democracy.
But now, for the first time in our country's history, a generation of American women have fewer rights than their mothers did.
My daughter, the fourth Margaret in my family, is now less free than I was at her age.
This is a grave moment for American women and for our democracy. The Supreme Court has taken away the freedom of half the population, freedom that most American women have known for their entire lives.
It seems daunting to contemplate where we go from here. But we have been in similar fights before. We have to keep fighting. We have to organize, mobilize, vote, and do everything in our power to protect our Senate majority – because if Mitch McConnell becomes the Majority Leader, he will ban abortion nationwide.
We owe it to ourselves and the next generation — to women like my daughter, Margaret number four — to keep fighting.
So please, join me in this fight by splitting $25 or any amount you can afford between my campaign and CommonGood to continue the progress we've been working on for hundreds of years. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mha?refcode=20220712_CGVA_Hassan]

Thank you.
With every good wish,
Maggie Hassan

My grandmother, Margaret Cooke Byers, was born in 1897 and turned 22 on the day that Congress passed the 19th Amendment, which allowed women to vote. My mother, Peggy Byers Wood, saw women achieve the right to control their own bodies, finances, and futures with the Roe decision. I am the third Margaret, becoming the second woman in the history of America to be elected both Governor and Senator. Over the course of my grandmother's, my mother's, and my lifetime, women have made tremendous progress towards achieving their rights as full and equal citizens in our democracy. But now, for the first time in our country's history, a generation of American women have fewer rights than their mothers did. My daughter, the fourth Margaret in my family, is now less free than I was at her age. This is a grave moment for American women and for our democracy. The Supreme Court has taken away the freedom of half the population, freedom that most American women have known for their entire lives. It seems daunting to contemplate where we go from here. But we have been in similar fights before. We have to keep fighting. We have to organize, mobilize, vote, and do everything in our power to protect our Senate majority – because if Mitch McConnell becomes the Majority Leader, he will ban abortion nationwide. We owe it to ourselves and the next generation — to women like my daughter, Margaret number four — to keep fighting. So please, join me in this fight by splitting $25 or any amount you can afford between my campaign and CommonGood to continue the progress we've been working on for hundreds of years. body:
| | | Mecou (Hello) We hope you and your loved ones are well. This month, we bring you less of a newsletter, and more of a whole-hearted request on behalf of the Water. Please read on to learn what is needed from us, Water Protectors, right now... **_PIPELINE NEWS & ACTION NEEDED_** **We have until *this Thursday* July 14th at 5pm (3 day****s!)****to Submit a Public Comment to the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) to STOP M****VP.** The corporation claims their destructive pipeline is near completion, but it is *not* true. Thanks to the efforts of everyday people participating in comment periods like these, MVP is missing 4 separate federal authorizations needed in order to move forward. subject: It was an easy choice
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Michael Waltz for Congress
body:
| | | Peter, When I was deciding what to do with my life, joining the U.S. Army was an easy choice.

That isn’t to say the journey wasn’t difficult. Being a Green Beret tested me physically and mentally more than anything I’d ever experienced.
---
[](http://links.mwaltzforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d89142ed55974e2696402eb6b29e4daf&_m=59321fbd50de4d0fa5809285c2ba3886&_e=pSHL7EEqrwLaUbOXfyIobu3tihzGX47WOB6vA3LLlPPCxRADZy-as8FcxXgyXfWZglCLCVKtisvX5W06_eSYSh4AZxGn-S5QenOGKFn_j6bPSCcvqX9UhK1ieE_bWF5fEbcHFau028ot54gfPu4817RiyGqfrWzBJHuXuWaYxpi8jdGc7dVdiQT_kteYXz7G9jKnoWwGlGlLJropG6eCY6a8QXEe1Gs0EImGGj8TfPsZ2ek1pH7mookfKaIyj1V9nvWHiaHHut2xYqaaA5dbvH6ctfaKsdzUXQmdL4xQL67u78DRjKGDqZM7laj1geMsEV0kzKXVWzOcoPvwH8u4PI4uq2Q113tPp9XCDS3I6IvfFeIorntQlXKJw8U3bTmfHccJ1WYHmlZZnQ5k6dEyrw%3D%3D)
---
_But I knew that without warriors who were willing to put their life on the line to serve, the freedoms that we love would be ripped out from under us._

I’m proud to say I’ve spent over two decades of my life defending democracy both as a U.S. Army Green Beret and as a member of Congress, but my work is far from over.

clean_body: | | | Peter, When I was deciding what to do with my life, joining the U.S. Army was an easy choice. That isn’t to say the journey wasn’t difficult. Being a Green Beret tested me physically and mentally more than anything I’d ever experienced. But I knew that without warriors who were willing to put their life on the line to serve, the freedoms that we love would be ripped out from under us. I’m proud to say I’ve spent over two decades of my life defending democracy both as a U.S. Army Green Beret and as a member of Congress, but my work is far from over. When I look back on my career, I don’t have any regrets, Peter. There were definitely sacrifices made - time away from my family, living abroad without the comforts of home, and the stress that comes with combat can wear you down. But all of these struggles are worth it to be able to live in the freest nation on Earth. I’m not done working for America, and I know you aren’t either. In Service, | | Col. As a fourth-generation farmer, I’ve always valued the deep connection humans have with our breathtaking landscapes, natural resources, and outdoor recreation.

Yet, throughout my lifetime, I’ve seen the destruction of climate change and environmental degradation take hold of our communities, and directly harm our way of life.

Washington State is lucky to be home to vast federally-protected public lands and National Parks, and it is more important than ever to have leaders in Congress who will work to preserve these invaluable resources for future generations.

**July is National Parks and Recreation Month – let’s take this moment to reaffirm our commitment to the protection of public natural resources and activities, for the overall well-being of our communities.[Add your name right away to join me!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47738192/355437764/-1250353851?refcode=DW_EM_PT_90DO_220712_1_1&refcode2=89a93568-0e02-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&contactdata=OHaRxgrVNU4K0%2FmjbSdl5LWMj5%2BYw%2BbfBgwmem21O1ZFGuHMGxZiG7EoNa94oC9L&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OWE5MzU2OC0wZTAyLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kb634NY8wi-DCfMEiArKbQODO6m4XWd6MNJ5w8lTHg0=&emci=6d717e36-5b01-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=89a93568-0e02-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=7651992)** | | **[SIGN ON](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47738193/355437765/-1250353851?refcode=DW_EM_PT_90DO_220712_1_1&refcode2=89a93568-0e02-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&contactdata=OHaRxgrVNU4K0%2FmjbSdl5LWMj5%2BYw%2BbfBgwmem21O1ZFGuHMGxZiG7EoNa94oC9L&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OWE5MzU2OC0wZTAyLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kb634NY8wi-DCfMEiArKbQODO6m4XWd6MNJ5w8lTHg0=&emci=6d717e36-5b01-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=89a93568-0e02-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=7651992)**

#
---
Peter — I’m running for Governor to take on the big fights and continue building a future of opportunity and justice for every Oregonian. I’ve got a track record of fighting for Oregon families — from passing paid sick leave, to expanding background checks on gun sales, to raising the minimum wage, to protecting access to reproductive health care. But it’s not nearly enough. Oregon needs a leader who puts people first, who prioritizes justice and equity, who brings people together, and inspires all of us to reach for a better future. **That’s why I’m asking for your personal endorsement.** [**Will you become an official supporter of my campaign for Governor to move Oregon forward?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47738464/355438838/857154942?refcode=AU_TK_EG_GEN_GEN_AC_20220712_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMzNiMjdmNy0wZjAyLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0BKWnr1ZyYNKFouX1YfCXCKXTta2hVH4HKp0xhA0wbI=&emci=08bcce2d-0302-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=133b27f7-0f02-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=15353729) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47738465/355438839/857154942?refcode=AU_TK_EG_GEN_GEN_AC_20220712_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMzNiMjdmNy0wZjAyLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0BKWnr1ZyYNKFouX1YfCXCKXTta2hVH4HKp0xhA0wbI=&emci=08bcce2d-0302-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=133b27f7-0f02-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=15353729)
---
In the aftermath of the Supreme Court’s _Dobbs_ decision overturning _Roe v. Wade_ , abortion rights will now be determined on a state-by-state basis. That means Oregon’s next governor will have to step up and lead to make sure abortion remains accessible in our state.
We need a real champion of reproductive rights more than ever. Christine Drazan has frequently touted her long-standing support from anti-abortion extremist group Oregon Right to Life. And Betsy Johnson recently got excited about an anti-choice extremist running “Republicans for Betsy.” That’s why I am the only candidate in this race endorsed by Planned Parenthood PAC of Oregon and Pro-Choice Oregon.
And with gun violence taking a huge toll on communities across the country, I’m the only candidate with the courage to stand up to the NRA and fight for common-sense gun laws to keep our communities safer. I’ve been endorsed by Giffords PAC, and I’m a Moms Demand Action Gun Sense Candidate. My opponents have both earned an “A” rating from the NRA.
**From reproductive rights to gun violence prevention to taking action on climate, the winner of the Governor’s race will have a _lot_ of power over the future of Oregon. This is a consequential election for everyone, so it will be critical to have your support in this tough race.**
[**If we’re going to win, we need an all-hands-on-deck approach. Will you join me and personally endorse the campaign?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47738466/355438840/857154942?refcode=AU_TK_EG_GEN_GEN_AC_20220712_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMzNiMjdmNy0wZjAyLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0BKWnr1ZyYNKFouX1YfCXCKXTta2hVH4HKp0xhA0wbI=&emci=08bcce2d-0302-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=133b27f7-0f02-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=15353729)
Thank you for having my back. It really makes a difference.
Tina
Tina for Oregon
PO Box 42307
Portland, OR 97242 **[tinafororegon.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47738467/355438841/1133357015?refcode=AU_TK_EG_GEN_GEN_AC_20220712_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMzNiMjdmNy0wZjAyLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0BKWnr1ZyYNKFouX1YfCXCKXTta2hVH4HKp0xhA0wbI=&emci=08bcce2d-0302-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=133b27f7-0f02-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=15353729) | [info@tinafororegon.com](mailto:info@tinafororegon.com) | [Privacy Policy](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47738468/355438842/-1830937231?refcode=AU_TK_EG_GEN_GEN_AC_20220712_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMzNiMjdmNy0wZjAyLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0BKWnr1ZyYNKFouX1YfCXCKXTta2hVH4HKp0xhA0wbI=&emci=08bcce2d-0302-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=133b27f7-0f02-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=15353729)** | Paid for by Friends of Tina Kotek

Wade , abortion rights will now be determined on a state-by-state basis. That means Oregon’s next governor will have to step up and lead to make sure abortion remains accessible in our state. We need a real champion of reproductive rights more than ever. Christine Drazan has frequently touted her long-standing support from anti-abortion extremist group Oregon Right to Life. And Betsy Johnson recently got excited about an anti-choice extremist running “Republicans for Betsy.” That’s why I am the only candidate in this race endorsed by Planned Parenthood PAC of Oregon and Pro-Choice Oregon. And with gun violence taking a huge toll on communities across the country, I’m the only candidate with the courage to stand up to the NRA and fight for common-sense gun laws to keep our communities safer. I’ve been endorsed by Giffords PAC, and I’m a Moms Demand Action Gun Sense Candidate. My opponents have both earned an “A” rating from the NRA. From reproductive rights to gun violence prevention to taking action on climate, the winner of the Governor’s race will have a lot of power over the future of Oregon. This is a consequential election for everyone, so it will be critical to have your support in this tough race. Thank you for having my back. It really makes a difference. Tina Tina for Oregon PO Box 42307 Portland, OR 97242 | mailto:info@tinafororegon.com | | Paid for by Friends of Tina Kotek

| | Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family.

name: Val Demings
subject: why I decided to run
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Val Demings for U
body:
a 50-50 Senate isn't working for you or our country
| | |
---
Friend: I am coming up on one of the biggest fundraising deadlines of the election year – and in a race as competitive as this, it couldn't be more important to get off to the strongest possible start.
I'm sure your inbox is filled with emails right now, but **this isn't the typical kind of fundraising message you might expect, so I hope you'll keep reading. What I'm about to tell you is why I decided to run, and it's important. **
When I'm in the middle of make-or-break moments like tonight for my Senate race, my mind often goes back to Jacksonville – back to the tiny house I grew up in with six brothers and sisters. Things weren't always easy. Mom was a maid, Dad was a janitor, and although we didn't have a lot of money, we had each other.
In fact, it was Mom who used to say to me: "Never grow tired of doing good, Val." This inspired me to get into public service, and ever since, growing tired of doing what's right has never been an option. From my time as a social worker to my time as police chief to my time as a representative in Congress, I've held this mantra close to my heart.
**_Never tire, _I remind myself, as experts say my race in Florida is one of Democrats' best opportunities to protect and expand our Senate majority.**

**_Never tire_ , I repeat, as polls show me statistically tied with my extremist opponent.

_Never tire_ , I say, as I head into yet another major fundraising deadline thousands of dollars behind where I need to be.**
The fact of the matter is that a 50-50 Senate isn't working for you or our country. So my promise to you is this: **I will _never tire_ in this work to expand our majority and secure a future for voting rights, reproductive freedom and all our shared values.**
**[I ask a lot of you because I have so much faith that you'll never tire _, _either. You know the stakes of this election, so before my most important fundraising deadline of the election year thus far, will you chip in $5 or more right now? Every dollar will help me defeat Marco Rubio and expand our Democratic Senate majority.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47738835/355440052/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3738-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOTM1ZjRhNS0xMDAyLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nMVNr5hAej89t9iLkuPxQ7pyinRwFOM7smSvc2or19Y=)**

name: American Update
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9467%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=u1KRcAguAqQgBfgTVNBe%2bw&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38594%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=n0fp5KAA4lg%2bvalGuPLSOA&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38505%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0cKTNB%2bgjhO3Zu51IfPocg&sysid=1)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38505%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0cKTNB%2bgjhO3Zu51IfPocg&sysid=1)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future. So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below: And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. name: Kristina Karamo
subject: News from the trail, Holiday week
body:
What a great week it has been on the trail!

Kristina started out the Big Holiday weekend on July 1st at the Bay City Fireworks Festival. We then headed to the 7th Annual Flint Water Festival to enjoy the festivities and meet many hard working Michiganders face to face. We spent the 4th in Kentwood appearing in their local parade, and enjoyed Grandville's 4th of July celebrations afterwards.

We were then on to the Berlin Fair which was celebrating its 167th year, where we spoke with members of our agricultural community on how Kristina plans to take her vision to Lansing.

Next up was Traverse City for the famous 96th annual National Cherry Festival, one of Michigan's premiere celebrations. We stayed in Traverse City Wednesday through Saturday and Kristina was proud to be featured in an interview with Ron Jolly on WTCM.

Saturday morning Kristina was featured as the keynote speaker at the Grand Traverse County GOP Leadership Breakfast where she spoke to the urgent need to secure all Michigan elections, and restore election integrity to our great state. We then enjoyed participating in the Cherry Festival Parade.

"It was great getting to meet so many patriots who share the same concerns I have about the way the SOS office is being run! Irrespective of political affiliation I'm determined to serve all Michiganders!"

Looking forward to another busy week talking with fellow Patriots!

body:
The deadline to register to vote in the August 2 primary election is TODAY. Deliver your paper application or complete the online voter registration. | | | |
---
| | | Friends,

TODAY is the last day to register to vote or make changes to your voter registration for the August 2 primary election.

To be eligible to participate in the primary election, you must be registered to vote. Deliver your paper application to your county election office or complete the online voter registration [HERE](https://scottschwab.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=637dedc6f5c04616f44b83bbf&id=1950bcae64&e=e4cd931cf2).

There will be an important constitutional amendment on the August 2 primary ballot, and it is imperative that Republicans participate and support our Kansas conservative values in the upcoming election.

I strongly encourage you to register to vote, update your voter information, and make a plan to cast your vote in support of Value Them Both on August 2.

Respectfully,
---
|
---
| Scott Schwab
Secretary of State
