body:
Facing an extreme GOP and right-wing Supreme Court, we have to take immediate action.
#
Peter, things are only going to get worse if we don’t do three things.
A radical, extremist Supreme Court and right-wing state legislatures are taking away our rights and threatening our democracy. If we don’t act now, it could be too late to protect our elections, abortions rights, the environment, and so much more.
We must end the filibuster, pass legislation to codify _Roe v. Wade_ and Expand the Supreme Court, and hold all those responsible for the January 6 insurrection accountable. **This is how we protect our rights AND our democracy.**
[**Can you chip in $3 to support Pramila’s fight for our rights, freedoms, and democracy? We must get these critical things done before the midterm elections, so please, contribute what you can today.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14539?refcode=em20220712-1417&t=1&akid=1417%2E420207%2EBiYSN5)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14539?refcode=em20220712-1417&t=20&akid=1417%2E420207%2EBiYSN5)**
**Getting rid of the filibuster** is the only way we can codify _Roe_ and pass legislation to Expand the Court.
**Codifying _Roe_** is a step Congress must take to protect abortion rights for people across the country.
**Expanding the Supreme Court is a key way to fight for our rights and our democracy** — expanding the Court will allow President Biden to appoint Justices that will protect our rights, freedoms, environment, and democracy. If we don’t act now after such a destructive Court term, our democracy is in serious jeopardy. The Supreme Court will be hearing a case next term that could destabilize our elections in 2024 — we must act now.
**Holding all those involved in the January 6 attack on the Capitol accountable** is critical to ensure something like it doesn’t happen again. We must show that there are consequences for efforts to undermine our democratic elections and that encouraging such attacks on our democracy is a punishable offense.
This is what our fight is about right now, even as we organize and campaign to hold our Democratic majorities in the House and Senate. It’s a lot of work and Pramila needs your support.
[**Peter, please contribute $3 today to help Pramila advocate for action to protect our rights and our elections. This is an important time to keep up our fight and never give in to the right-wing GOP.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14539?refcode=em20220712-1417&t=21&akid=1417%2E420207%2EBiYSN5)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14539?refcode=em20220712-1417&t=22&akid=1417%2E420207%2EBiYSN5)**
Thank you for remaining with us in this fight.
In solidarity,
Team Jayapal

body:
I put my life on the line to defend the expression of faith, American families, and our freedom.| | | Fellow American, I put my life on the line to defend American families and our freedom. I fought terrorists over seas who threatened these values, _only to come home and find some people in my own government in opposition to them._

**Radical far-leftists in Congress have aligned themselves against the very things I fought for: faith, family, and freedom.**

My values as a Green Beret weren’t being represented by DC politicians. That’s why my call to serve was reignited and I _knew_ I had to get involved in my community.

I’m not done fighting for our country and I hope you aren’t either. It’s time we take back control from the far-Left and prioritize Conservative values once again.

I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family.

body:
Thank you so very much.
#
Omg, Derek.
BEST. FUNDRAISING QUARTER. EVER!!!! 🤯
✔️ $11 million raised
✔️ 358,000+ donations
✔️ 69% new donors
Gisele + I are overwhelmed with gratitude. We *truly* can't thank #TeamFetterman enough.
**Yinz are INCREDIBLE. Thank you, thank you, THANK YOU!!! 😭😭**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220712-1?refcode=em20220712-6496&refcode2=6496_434096_IG6jom&akid=6496%2E434096%2EIG6jom)
I want to be clear tho. This incredible goal can’t only be a moment of celebration.
Because I really can’t overstate how your online support *literally* keeps our campaign going.
Unlike Dr. Oz, I’m not funding this campaign with personal wealth. I don’t rely on corporate PAC fundies, and I certainly do *not* have the backing of the GOP money machine. We’re funding our campaign the RIGHT WAY, even if that means it’s harder.
**At the end of the day, I’m just a guy in shorts who can’t even get his kids to clean up their rooms.** So I want you to know how much I’m counting on you + how I am *truly* grateful for your support, Derek.
The truth is that while raising $11 million is record-breakingly impressive, we simply can’t stop there, cash in, and expect to win on Election Day.
Soberingly, PA is ranked by both Nate Silver’s 538 and CNN as the #1 Most Likely to Flip U.S. Senate Seat in the country. All eyes are on PA, and the Republicans want to win the Commonwealth just as badly as we do.
The GOP is preparing to come for us with *literally* everyone they’ve got — from spending million$ on TV ads attacking me + my record, to spreading lies + disinformation about my campaign.
So please, if you’re able to, I ask that you consider making a contribution of any amount to our campaign. **If you make your first donation of $5 right now, we’ll be able to start off Q3 strong + prepared for the MAGA dark money attacks.**
**Here’s a personal link you can use:[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220712-1?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220712-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220712-6496&refcode2=6496_434096_IG6jom&akid=6496%2E434096%2EIG6jom)**

Derek, thank you so *very* much for your support. I just *really* can’t thank you enough for all the ways you support this campaign, big + small. I am so incredibly grateful. 🥰
Love,
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

name: Ralph Rebandt For Governor
subject: PRESS RELEASE
body:
Detroit Hosts Rally For Ralph Rebandt

| [ ](http://www.ralphrebandtforgovernor.com/?e=35c30c37841d37cfa9d73635bc93e640&utm_source=ralphrebandtforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=detroit_press_release&n=1)
---
# ****
**Detroit Hosts Rally for Candidate for Michigan Governor Ralph Rebandt** Ralph Rebandt, Candidate for Michigan Governor is honored that the residents of Detroit are hosting a rally for him on Wednesday, July 12th. The Black America Report media will be covering the event which offers free food for guests, a bounce house for kids, and an amazing line-up of speakers for adults. “Hosting this event in my honor humbles me because residents have told me that both Republican and Democrat candidates and politicians have ignored Detroit. The people of Detroit want a voice, not a hand out, and they trust me to make that happen. I won’t let them down.” The event, held from 1:00 – 4:00 pm will take place at 15142 Joy Road in Detroit. Everyone is welcome. Accompanying Candidate Ralph Rebandt on the speakers list will be Candidate for Attorney General, Matt Deperno; Pastor and Community Leader, Ellis Smith; Pastor of Outreach, Zion Helms, Founder of the Black America Report, Articia Bomer; Author of _The Black America Report,_ Ramon Jackson; Candidate for State House District 1, Paula Campbell; Candidate for District 4 Beth Socia; and author of _A Faith of Equal Standing_ and founder of Faith of Equal Standing Ministries, and Adam Rebandt, son of Candidate Ralph Rebandt. Candidate for Secretary of State Kristina Karamo will have representation, although she won’t be able to attend the event personally. The rally will focus on “Making Detroit a Lighthouse” as a blueprint for other communities to follow. Speaker topics, among others, will center on the importance of individual responsibility, family values, our Judeo-Christian heritage, the integrity of our elections, a faith of equal standing, and Rebandt’s Lighthouse Initiatives for education and small business. “This is one of the most important events of our campaign”, Rebandt said, “Detroit gets it. The citizens here have so much to offer, and they’re just as tired as I am of sending the same type of candidates to Lansing and expecting different results. This August, and again in November, they will speak, and this time, they will be heard.”

name: Ron DeSantis
subject: California or Florida?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWoSrsChNt

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWoSrsChNt

Friend,

Over the
past three years, we have been called to make choices and answer
questions we did not expect.

Questions
about how, in a world that seemed frightening and different, we
were going to raise our kids, continue to put food on the table,
and care for our communities?

And
questions that feel further out now like, how does our government
interact with its citizenry in a time of crisis?

How is
our government - one of the people, by the people, for the people
- meant to protect life, but not stifle liberty?

In
crisis, do we foster freedom? Or do we force our citizens down?

Well,
over the past three years I believe we have had the truth
revealed about those two vastly different approaches. Not in an
academic textbook or in a theoretical debate, but in the harsh
reality of governing during COVID. You could not find two more
starkly different examples than the free state of Florida and the
woke tyranny of Gavin Newsom's California.

It isn't
hard to understand why the Governor of California wants to talk
about Florida. It's part of the one topic he tries to focus on:
Anything but California.

Let's
take a look at the record of the "liberal elite" in California:

They
locked their kids out of public schools at the behest of the
teachers' unions.
They
forced small businesses to close with many never to re-open
again.
They
hobbled law enforcement and allowed drugs and crime to destroy
their cities.

Everything on that list is a tragedy, and it's only made worse by
the disregard and disrespect shown by leaders like Gavin Newsom.
The idea of locking down your citizens and then darting off to
the fanciest restaurant in the state to rub their noses in it.

It's
wrong, it's disgusting, and it's no surprise that every day
driving around Florida I see more and more California license
plates as a result.

In
Florida, we didn't bludgeon our people with government mandates;
we lifted people up - protecting their jobs, their businesses,
and their kids' education.

Help us
keep Florida free in November >>>

We didn't
lock business owners out of their livelihoods and we didn't lock
people out of their jobs.

In
Florida we didn't turn a blind eye to crime and drugs, we put
criminals behind bars, and we kept our streets safe.

Gavin
Newsom doesn't want to talk about California, and I don't blame
him. But the reality is, there are plenty of woke liberal
billionaires on Gavin Newsom's speed dial who do not want to see
individual freedom succeed. They don't want to see it succeed in
Florida or anywhere else.

Because
if it succeeds, it shows everyone that the top down nanny-state
tyranny of California is avoidable - Free people making their own
decisions are better off than a locked down citizenry dictated to
by elitists.

That's
why I need your help. Gavin Newsom, funded by Hollywood liberals,
Big Tech billionaires, and who knows who else is running ads in
Florida. I need your help to fight back. On our side are free
people who care to stay that way. On their side is everyone who
thinks they know better.

Show them
that we intend to stay free: Make a donation right now to help us
fight back. You can use this secure link.

Sincerely,

Ron
DeSantis

MAKE A
DONATION NOW

Paid by Ron DeSantis, Republican, for Governor

name: Stacey Abrams
subject: re: public education
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ABRAMS FOR GOVERNOR |
body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

Georgia’s students and their families should always come first. A strong
early start and fully funded public education are fundamental to building
a state where every child and every family can thrive.

But today, Georgia’s students face an uncertain future. They’ll be back in
classrooms in just a few weeks with a public education system in crisis.
Oversized classrooms and an educator shortage. About 30 percent of Georgia
teachers reported that they are unlikely to remain in education for
another five years — and our state faces a challenge of recruiting new
educators, too.

The reality: to invest in our students, we must invest in educators.
That’s why I have a comprehensive plan that will boost starting teacher
pay higher than Mississippi AND move Georgia into the top 10 (from 21st)
in teacher salaries.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1490?refcode=sa_em_220712_B1_TeacherPay_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=942%2E1862389%2EPjjZ1X ]Derek, if
elected governor, I will be committed to making sure Georgia’s students
and their families come first. Can you chip in to power my campaign for
One Georgia now?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1490?refcode=sa_em_220712_B1_TeacherPay_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=942%2E1862389%2EPjjZ1X ]DONATE

Derek, as a
product of Georgia’s public schools, I know that public education is the
passport to a better future in which every child can live out their
dreams. That’s why I have a comprehensive plan to support children from
cradle to career.

Georgia’s teachers face a range of challenges. One of the key reasons it
is difficult to recruit and retain teachers is low pay. Low wages force
teachers to drop out of the profession or leave the state entirely, and
the lack of long-term financial growth causes fewer teachers to enter the
profession. Right now, Georgia’s teachers make less than they did twenty
years ago — in real dollar terms.

But Brian Kemp doesn’t care. He’s left our teachers and students behind
along with so many other Georgians across the state.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1490?refcode=sa_em_220712_B1_TeacherPay_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=942%2E1862389%2EPjjZ1X ]If you believe in my vision of effective and excellent public
education, make your
first contribution to

subject: Anne Marie Schubert Endorses Nathan Hochman for Attorney General
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nathan Hochman for Attorney General 2022
body:
The Sacramento County District Attorney, an Independent, endorsed Hochman, her primary election opponent in the race for California Attorney General. | | |
---
| | | “As a career prosecutor and Sacramento District Attorney, I know how important it is to have an Attorney General who actively works with law enforcement to get criminals off the streets and keep our communities safe. Unfortunately, appointed AG Rob Bonta is not upholding that critical duty. That's why I ran for Attorney General in the primary and why I am supporting Nathan Hochman this November in the general election. Nathan has what’s needed: experienced criminal justice leadership for over 30 years, pragmatic solutions, and independence needed to reverse rising crime rates in California, protect crime victims, and keep our communities safe. If we want to stop the chaos in our state, Nathan is now by far our best shot. I am happy to endorse him and ask you to please join me in supporting his campaign." **-Sacramento County District Attorney Anne Marie Schubert**
---
| Thank you for the support, District Attorney Anne Marie Schubert!

Anne Marie ran a strong campaign for Attorney General in the primary and has done incredible work putting criminals behind bars as District Attorney of Sacramento County. Her work cracking cold cases with innovative DNA investigations and her strong record fighting back against unemployment fraud are just two examples of her exemplary leadership.
---
|
---
| Her endorsement is incredibly meaningful to me, as it sends a strong signal that with the primary behind us, now is the time for Republicans, Independents, and Democrats to unite and focus our energy on restoring public safety to California.

Anne Marie is one of the latest Independents to back my campaign, which is defined not by party, but by a willingness to challenge the status quo and enact meaningful change to protect the safety and security of Californians.

I am very thankful to have the endorsement of District Attorney Schubert and look forward to announcing additional new members of Team Hochman in the weeks to come.

Best,

Nathan Hochman
_Candidate for California Attorney General_

Hey Peter Willis,
Over 39,000 New Yorkers work at Amazon Fulfillment Warehouses. They’re being exploited today to bring you “deals.”
In New York, Amazon has:
* Refused to accommodate pregnant workers and workers with disabilities
* Fired employees for organizing a union
* Failed to protect its workers during the pandemic

**Amazon spent $4.3 million on anti-union consultants in 2021 alone** , making them one of the biggest union-busters out there. _But they are losing the battle on workers’ rights._
Amazon workers are organizing across the country for higher wages, job security, safer working conditions, more paid time off, better medical leave options, and longer breaks.
**As a former union member, I am not afraid to stand up to Amazon and other corporations and fight for workers’ rights — I’ve been doing it since day one as a community organizer and the only labor candidate in my race.**
I believe the needs of our communities should always come before the needs of billionaires.

It might be hard to believe, but Amazon workers making less than a living wage pay more in taxes than Amazon does.
_That’s a huge problem._ Middle and lower-income families shouldn’t bear the financial burden of billion-dollar companies unwilling to pay their fair share.
And while Amazon is one of the more famous examples of this, they are not alone. Many politicians rely on Amazon to fund their campaign. I’ll never be one of them because I’m rejecting ALL corporate lobbyist money, especially from union busters, in my race for NY-03.
I'd rather win the favor of working people like you, Peter Willis.
**That’s why my endorsement from the Laundry, Distribution, and Food Service Joint Board, Workers United, SEIU means so much to me.**
They represent about 8,500 New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut workers, and they know I’m committed to fighting for the working families of this district.

Team,
It’s hard to believe I’m already saying this – but we have less than a month to go until our August 2nd Michigan primary.
This year has really flown by: I’ve made the move to Lansing, hit the ground in the new 7th district, and just last week we launched our first campaign ad on TVs across the Lansing media market (you can check it out here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220712] if you haven’t seen it already).
I don’t have a primary challenger this time around, which means I’ll be focusing my attention for the next few weeks on continuing to build out our strong volunteer networks, registering people to vote, and continuing to meet voters in the new parts of my district. On the Republican side, my presumed opponent is trying to win against a well-funded write-in campaign. The GOP feels at least somewhat worried about it, because their Super PACs have spent nearly half a million dollars to make sure the party favorite wins.
Ahead of that August 2nd primary we have an important filing deadline coming up tomorrow, on July 13th. Before a primary election, campaigns are required to report how much they’ve raised since the end of their last quarter – in this case, June 30th. That means we have another opportunity to show my opponent what Team Slotkin can accomplish in just 13 days.
So, I’m asking if you’d consider making a contribution before that July 13th deadline – both to help me prepare for November AND to show the other side what they’re up against! [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220712]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220712]
Elissa

## July 8, 2022
|
| | |
---|---|---
| Fellow Patriot, In the past few weeks, the Supreme Court has issued some of the most consequential decisions of our lifetime. In many ways these decisions have redirected the course of history—back towards conservatism and sound governance. Here’s what you should know about the Court’s actions in upholding our Second Amendment rights, defending life, and protecting religious freedom. We should joyfully celebrate these monumental victories, but we must never forget what brought us to this point. Thousands of conservatives worked tirelessly for decades towards a victory they knew they might not see in their lifetimes. These men and women toiled faithfully through grueling democratic processes and gut-wrenching cultural warfare, and after 50 years their efforts paid off—tenfold. But the fight continues. Here in Arizona, we still have work ahead in order to affirm the sanctity of life, secure our border, and protect our constitutional rights. The Democrats have already started pushing to enshrine abortion in the Arizona constitution. We cannot afford an Attorney General who will back down or go rogue. I have skin in the game and I promise to fight unrelentingly to secure Arizona’s freedom and prosperity. For Arizona, |
| |
| | | | | |
---|---
| | |
---|---|---
| Tiffany Shedd |
| |
|

|
---
| | | | |
---

| | | |
---
_New York State Rifle and Pistol Assn. v. Bruen_
|
---
Prior to this decision, the State of New York required citizens to have “proper cause” to carry a gun outside their home. The Court ruled that this requirement violated the Fourteenth Amendment because it prevented law-abiding citizens from exercising their Second Amendment right to keep and bear arms for self-defense. As your next Attorney General, and someone with extensive experience exercising my own Second Amendment rights, you can count on me to stand up to the anti-gun mob and protect your right to keep and bear arms.

|
---
| | | | |
---

| | | |
---
_Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization_
|
---
I can’t emphasize enough the significance of this decision to the pro-life movement. We have waited for this day for nearly 50 years. My heart aches for those not here to celebrate such a momentous day. The decision to overturn Roe and Casey does not make abortion illegal nationwide. Instead, each state will now have authority to legislate abortion as they see fit. This means the fight for life has come home, and we must each carry the torch in support of conservative candidates who will continue to lead the pro-life charge. We cannot yield to the reckless mob that has targeted the homes of Supreme Court Justices, threatened their families, vandalized crisis pregnancy centers, and even attempted to assassinate Justice Kavanaugh. We are on the right side of history, and as your Attorney General I will relentlessly defend the sanctity of life while enforcing our abortion laws.

|
---
| | | | |
---

| | | |
---
_Kennedy v. Bremerton School District_
|
---
The woke mob wants you to think this case hinges on mandating school prayer. The truth? Joseph Kennedy lost his job as a high school football coach after kneeling midfield to offer a quiet personal prayer after games. This case never involved forcing kids to join in a religious prayer, but centered instead on allowing Mr. Kennedy to exercise his right to religious expression. The Court held that the Free Exercise and Free Speech Clauses of the First Amendment protect an individual who engages in personal religious observance from government reprisal. This decision marked a huge win for religious freedom and affirmed the right to free expression.

clean_body: Newsletter from Tiffany Shedd | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | July 8, 2022 | | | | ---|---|--- | Fellow Patriot, In the past few weeks, the Supreme Court has issued some of the most consequential decisions of our lifetime. In many ways these decisions have redirected the course of history—back towards conservatism and sound governance. Here’s what you should know about the Court’s actions in upholding our Second Amendment rights, defending life, and protecting religious freedom. We should joyfully celebrate these monumental victories, but we must never forget what brought us to this point. Thousands of conservatives worked tirelessly for decades towards a victory they knew they might not see in their lifetimes. These men and women toiled faithfully through grueling democratic processes and gut-wrenching cultural warfare, and after 50 years their efforts paid off—tenfold. But the fight continues. Here in Arizona, we still have work ahead in order to affirm the sanctity of life, secure our border, and protect our constitutional rights. The Democrats have already started pushing to enshrine abortion in the Arizona constitution. We cannot afford an Attorney General who will back down or go rogue. I have skin in the game and I promise to fight unrelentingly to secure Arizona’s freedom and prosperity. For Arizona, | | | | | | | | | ---|--- | | | ---|---|--- | Tiffany Shedd | | | | | | | | | | | | | | New York State Rifle and Pistol Assn. v. Bruen | Prior to this decision, the State of New York required citizens to have “proper cause” to carry a gun outside their home. The Court ruled that this requirement violated the Fourteenth Amendment because it prevented law-abiding citizens from exercising their Second Amendment right to keep and bear arms for self-defense. As your next Attorney General, and someone with extensive experience exercising my own Second Amendment rights, you can count on me to stand up to the anti-gun mob and protect your right to keep and bear arms. | | | | | | | | | | Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization | I can’t emphasize enough the significance of this decision to the pro-life movement. We have waited for this day for nearly 50 years. My heart aches for those not here to celebrate such a momentous day. The decision to overturn Roe and Casey does not make abortion illegal nationwide. Instead, each state will now have authority to legislate abortion as they see fit. This means the fight for life has come home, and we must each carry the torch in support of conservative candidates who will continue to lead the pro-life charge. We cannot yield to the reckless mob that has targeted the homes of Supreme Court Justices, threatened their families, vandalized crisis pregnancy centers, and even attempted to assassinate Justice Kavanaugh. We are on the right side of history, and as your Attorney General I will relentlessly defend the sanctity of life while enforcing our abortion laws. | | | | | | | | | | Kennedy v. Bremerton School District | The woke mob wants you to think this case hinges on mandating school prayer. The truth? Joseph Kennedy lost his job as a high school football coach after kneeling midfield to offer a quiet personal prayer after games. This case never involved forcing kids to join in a religious prayer, but centered instead on allowing Mr. Kennedy to exercise his right to religious expression. The Court held that the Free Exercise and Free Speech Clauses of the First Amendment protect an individual who engages in personal religious observance from government reprisal. This decision marked a huge win for religious freedom and affirmed the right to free expression. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Incorrect Ballots Sent To Pinal County Voters... | Read more from AZ Free News . | | | | | Editorial: Primary election | Read more from Pinal Central . | | | | | Primary Debate Attorney General | Watch the full AZGOP Attorney General Primary Debate . | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | July 13 @ 6:15pm - Greater Phoenix Republican Women AG Candidate Forum | July 14 @ 6:00pm - LD 25 Meeting | mailto:hattie@sheddforaz.com?subject=July%2015%20RSVP | July 16 @ 10:00am - Mohave County GOP Picnic | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Primary Date: August 2 Early Voting: July 6-29 Poll Hours: 6am - 7pm Absentee/Mail-In Deadline: August 2 | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | | ---|--- | | | | ---|--- | | | | ---|--- | | | | ---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | | Tiffany Shedd for Attorney General | PO Box 92, Eloy, AZ 85131 |

Friend,
I'm coming directly to you - one of this team's most engaged grassroots supporters - with some important news: **We launched a new TV ad highlighting the importance of protecting Democratic Senate control to stop Republicans from passing a nationwide abortion ban into law.**
But I need your help to keep spreading this message far and wide - because you know as well as I do that the stakes couldn't be higher. Here's the latest on our battle to protect this seat:
**FIRST,** Republicans made this seat a target - with RNC chairwoman and noted Trump apologist Ronna McDaniel opening a new national Republican campaign office in this state for the first time ever.
**THEN,** the campaign arm of the Senate GOP raised more than $50 MILLION to take back control of the chamber for Mitch McConnell - and they only need to flip one Democratic seat to do it.
**NOW,** Republicans are launching attack after attack against me - which is why we've set a goal to raise another $15,000 to keep broadcasting our new ad, spread our message of defending reproductive freedom far and wide, and win this race.
Friend, I've watched Mitch McConnell's tactics up close for years - and believe me, with that much cash in the GOP campaign coffers, it's scary to think about what he could do to our chances here.
He's counting on us to miss our fundraising goals. He's counting on signs of weakness from us. **I will never let that happen, but I 'm counting on your support to keep up the fight. So please, to keep taking the fight to Republicans with this new ad and to show extremist Republicans that we won't let them take this seat, can I count on your donation today?**

Dick

body: I became the first in my family to graduate college, the first Black woman to serve as Orlando's chief of police and a congresswoman --- | **Friend: I'm so close to reaching my daily fundraising goal, b****ut I'm still 13% short as of 6 p.m. ET – and in a race that could determine Senate control, I can’t afford to fall behind.** When I was growing up in Jacksonville, I was one of seven children living in a two-room house. We didn't have much, but with a lot of hard work, I became the first in my family to graduate college, the first Black woman to serve as Orlando's chief of police and a congresswoman. I took my parents' words of _never tire_ to heart, even when I was being counted out. That's why I'm running to defeat Marco Rubio in the Senate elections and expand my story of opportunity: So one day, every child can achieve the American Dream like I did. And the thing is, **since I launched my campaign last year, your support has made this race competitive: The Miami Times says I'm gaining ground in the polls. ** But national Republicans are taking notice of our grassroots team and are running relentless attack ads to stop our momentum. **_We can win – but I can't do this alone._** **I'm relying on the continued grassroots support of everyday Americans like you to win, friend:** [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47747025/355475637/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3733-fr-nd&recurring=0 or more to help me protect myself from the GOP&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMDk4YzMyZC0zMjAyLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xsAPyhY8zbWFDnpOVBoJS8Oayd4bpcmHCpVKLm6l1NA='s attack ads, reach more voters with my story of opportunity and flip Florida blue?

Peter,
Charlie Crist just BACKED OUT of a primary debate that was supposed to be hosted at Bethune-Cookman University — a historically Black university.
This is more than just cowardly — it’s insulting.
Charlie has made it clear that he doesn’t care about Black Floridians. That’s why he skipped out on an in-person forum at the Democratic Black Caucus and why he showed up late and left early during a Q&A at an influential Black church.
And let’s not forget that, as a member of the GOP, Charlie passed minimum sentencing laws and expanded the death penalty during the obviously racist “tough on crime” era of the Republican Party.
This is a pattern, Peter.
After four years of DeSantis’ racist policies, attacks on communities of color, and blatant bigotry, Black Floridians deserve a Governor who will uplift their voices and fight for their interests.
I’m ready to be that Governor. If you’re with me, help me send a message to Charlie Crist that we won’t stand for this disrespect. Click here to make a donation today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-jul-2022?refcode=712hbcu]

| | | | | Peter, I write with a simple request:[ Please follow me on Twitter](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te67082d3-ea97-4a25-bef9-756cfc30526f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) if you have an account. The January 6th Hearings today once again reminded us of the danger our democracy is in, especially the ease with which right-wingers can reach and do something akin to brainwashing their minions via social media. This is how they got their foot solidiers for their domestic terrorist attack against the Capitol on January 6th and their ongoing war against our Constitution. [PLEASE FOLLOW @CLIFFSCHECTER ON TWITTER](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tde84c16e-4251-483e-ae67-276e74fda598/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [Twitter is a place where we can push back](https://default.salsalabs.org/T859ee9dc-c5bd-4572-ba68-0409ee98e5f3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), organize together, undermine their talking points, put them on the defensive with smart messaging and share Democratic accomplishments with positive messages of our own--all in front of the media, who are pretty much all on this app. We do our best to send you emails every day to financially support our best candidates, and defeat their worst. Meanwhile, on Twitter there is a constant conversation in real time, one that can often define whether we are on the winning or losing side of issues, campaigns, candidacies and more. So not a huge ask here, [just please follow me there,](https://default.salsalabs.org/T81c3375c-6e23-45c6-b60f-b183d5d1e5b1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)where at least a dozen times per day I share news, ideas, pushback and more to fight the Republican authoritarian menace. So one last time [please go to Twitter and hit the follow button](https://default.salsalabs.org/T61cb57fa-dcf0-49c9-958e-7fdd4eb4749e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). We all want to be on message and responding as quickly as possible in a world with minute-to-minute news cycles. This is one thing where we can all make a difference. [PLEASE FOLLOW @CLIFFSCHECTER ON TWITTER](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc0e5f260-3d6b-4e90-b562-6ff19d23782f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you for all you do, and please have a wonderful evening. All my best, Cliff

body:
Make no mistake—this is a big win for the gun safety movement.
#

Today, the Senate voted to confirm Steve Dettelbach as Director of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives.
**Make no mistake—this is a big win for the gun safety movement.**
The ATF is the only agency in charge of regulating the gun industry and enforcing our nation’s gun laws. And now, for the first time since 2015, they will have a Senate-confirmed Director.
As the epidemic of gun violence in this country gets worse and worse, it’s never been more important to have a director who will prioritize public safety over the profits of the gun industry by combating gun trafficking and holding bad actors accountable.
[**This is a big success, and you should be proud of the role you played in making it happen. But there’s still so much to do to make our communities safe. | | | **Dear Peter,** **_Just one week_ until primary day!

We're making big decisions TODAY and TOMORROW about our final primary outreach. It comes down to money and we need your help!

[Are you in? Can you make a donation today and help us reach more voters over our most critical week?](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=7d26fe9233&e=0faa9de128)**

We need to raise another $10,000 ASAP to implement our outreach plan.

**[If everyone receiving this email chipped in, even a little, $10, $25, $50 or more, we'd reach that goal](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=c37446a310&e=0faa9de128)[. ](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=fb11a2c44e&e=0faa9de128)[Click here to donate.](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=a74701bf38&e=0faa9de128)**

I'm grateful to have knocked on thousands of doors and called thousands of voters across the five counties in our district. The conversations have been invaluable! **This is what campaigns SHOULD look like.

We need leaders focused on the people who elected them -- not themselves, the well-connected, or Big Money special interests.**

**[If you agree, please make a donation today to support our final primary push.](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=7881b33c8b&e=0faa9de128) We cannot do this without you.** Thank you again!
Ben

**In addition, here are four ways to get involved right now!**
1. **Tell 10 or 20 friends. **Text or call everyone you know.
2. **Knock on some doors in your neighborhood!** We can get you started today! [Sign up here to volunteer! ](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=c4a4f72255&e=0faa9de128)
3. **Greet voters outside your local voting place on Tuesday, July 19** : We want to be represented at EVERY precinct’s polling place. If interested, just respond to this email.
4. **Donate.** We need to place a big order of palm cards to hand out. We need more funds for digital ads. Everything costs money. [Please donate today.](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=79cb1ca5ff&e=0faa9de128)

Fellow American,

Up until just recently, Hispanics were expected and assumed to be Democrats by anyone with a passive interest in political demography. In fact, until recently, Hispanics were about as Democrat as suburbanites were Republican.

I’m helping to change that narrative. I’m not a “coconut” - brown on the outside, white on the inside - as some have called me. And I’m certainly not a “**self-hating Hispanic** ,” as others have labeled me. My name is Monica De La Cruz, a proud Hispanic Republican, and I’m running for Congress in Texas’ 15th Congressional District to flip a seat RED which has never been held by a Republican in its **HISTORY**.

** PLEASE LET ME EXPLAIN WHY I'M EMAILING YOU TODAY.**

**First:** Three short weeks ago, my friend Mayra Flores made history by flipping a **South Texas U.S. House seat Republican for the first time** , sending a loud message to the entire political class in Washington that as suspected, Hispanic voters are leaving the Democrat Party in DROVES.

**Then:** _Politico_ called my race “**central** ” to Republican’s efforts to flip the House. If you recall, the district I’m running to represent in Congress has **NEVER elected a Republican** to serve our interests in Washington. Democrats have a 100% winning streak dating back to **1903**. ** **

**Now:** I officially have an opponent. After waiting more than a year to find out who my general election opponent is going to be, I’m writing to tell you that I’ll be facing off against Michelle Vallejo. **She’s a far-left Democrat and she just won her primary by a mere 35 votes.**

To be frank, that’s almost incomprehensible. **35 votes**. I’ve been trying to let that sink in. I could easily fit **35** people into my home for an open house. **35** people have been at my campaign headquarters making phone calls and strategizing how to win this pivotal Congressional race.

body:
A recent Eagle column’s attack on Derek Schmidt for standing up against the Biden administration’s latest attempt to force its liberal politics into o| | |
---
| | **Schmidt running mate defends his opposition to USDA rule banning LGBT discrimination ** BY KATIE SAWYERSPECIAL TO THE EAGLE A recent Eagle column’s attack on Derek Schmidt for standing up against the Biden administration’s latest attempt to force its liberal politics into our kids’ schools (“Why is Derek Schmidt trying to allow anti-gay discrimination?” June 17) missed the mark by a mile. As Kansans know, America is in the midst of a vigorous national debate about who decides how and what our kids are taught. Most of us believe those decisions are best made locally by parents and elected and accountable school board members. Kansans can oppose discrimination — and Derek Schmidt and I do — while also standing against Washington telling us how to raise our kids. In fact, here’s the not-so-secret truth: Washington has no monopoly on virtue, and when it gets involved, everything gets political. As parents, we owe it to our kids to provide a learning environment that helps them grow and thrive, equipped with the skills to succeed in modern life. They should be taught American history, the good and the bad, free from controversial racial politics. Our girls should be afforded a level playing field against other girls — free from controversial gender politics — like I was when I competed in high school athletics. Derek Schmidt agrees with me on that. But Joe Biden and Laura Kelly don’t. One of Biden’s first acts as president was to issue a sweeping executive order instructing federal agencies to insert gender-identity politics into their operations. Last year, Biden’s federal Department of Education issued guidance to enforce his order in our schools. As a result, every school that preserves female-only sports and locker rooms risks losing funding or facing lawsuits. Now Biden’s federal Department of Agriculture has piled on, announcing new requirements to participate in federal nutrition programs including those that feed school kids. USDA claims its new rules have nothing to do with the culture wars and politics in schools, but that’s disingenuous — the USDA rules do not exist in a vacuum. They will be applied in schools together with the Department of Education rules that seek to punish noncompliance with Biden’s preferred gender politics. Several states’ school administrators around the country have objected to the new USDA requirements but acknowledge they will be forced to comply, as one put it, out of “caution and prudence” to “maintain a flow of federal funds to support children.” After all, the express or implied threat of losing federal funds can be a big hammer. That’s how USDA nutrition programs become another pawn in the Left’s culture wars. Through all this, Laura Kelly has stood silent while Derek Schmidt has stood up. As our state attorney general, Derek is suing the Biden administration to stop the Department of Education edict, and he is standing together with at least 30 state attorneys general, governors, and state superintendents against the new USDA decree. Laura Kelly was also wrong to twice veto the Fairness in Women’s Sports Act, which would protect female athletes from having to compete against biological males in sports. And she was wrong to veto the Parents Bill of Rights — which protects parental involvement in their kids’ education — dismissing it as the “worst thing we can possibly be doing.” As a mother, I find it a much worse thing that Biden is doing – trying to inject his preferred liberal politics into our schools. I’m frustrated by Laura Kelly standing against girls’ sports and parents, but not against Biden. I’m disappointed by the Eagle falsely asserting that opposing new federal mandates somehow equates to defending discrimination. It doesn’t. Derek Schmidt and I will keep Biden’s politics and his culture wars out of our schools. In Kansas, we can raise our kids just fine without the Biden administration forcing its liberal politics on our teachers, administrators, school board members, and parents. _Katie Sawyer is a Republican candidate for lieutenant governor and Attorney General Derek Schmidt’s running mate on the GOP ticket_

| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate. | | | | | | | Paid for by Friends of Chuck Morse | | | Friends of Chuck Morse | | PO Box 106 North Salem, NH 03073 | You received this email because you signed up on our website or made a purchase from us.

name: Andrea Rammuno
subject: After today’s call
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
I want to be able to surprise them with how many donors stepped up today.
#
Hi, Derek, it’s Andrea!
If we haven’t met before, I’m the National Finance Director for Fetterman for PA. I’m in charge of keeping track of our budget and making sure that our campaign has the resources we need to elect John Fetterman in November.
I’m reaching out today because my team at Fetterman HQ just had our weekly budget call, and Derek, I’m going to need your help.
Even though our campaign has officially been rated a toss-up by Nate Silver’s 538, we’re still experiencing the dreaded “summer slowdown” in fundraising (trust me, I’ve worked in PA politics for many years).
[**_So, I want to be able to surprise John with how many grassroots donors stepped up today. Can you help me out by chipping in a few bucks today?_**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220712-2?refcode=em20220712-6500&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6500_434096_5eVEwp&akid=6500%2E434096%2E5eVEwp)
**[Donate now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220712-2?refcode=em20220712-6500&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6500_434096_5eVEwp&akid=6500%2E434096%2E5eVEwp)**
Honestly, we're a tad bit short of where we need to be for fundraising in order to give a green light to ALL of our most urgent campaign priorities for this summer, like:
✅ Organizing staff to engage volunteers and register voters
✅ Field office funding so we can reach people in all of PA's 67 counties
✅ Official campaign merch so yinz can represent your Team Fetterman pride
✅ In-person and virtual events for John and Gisele to meet and greet supporters
✅ And a lot more. I'll spare you the whole list. (Trust me, it's pretty long.)
If we’re going to continue breaking records and crushing Dr. Oz’s attempt to buy this Senate seat, I need a few more folks to step up and chip in what they can before tomorrow’s budget meeting.
[**_So, Derek, will you chip in your first $5 or more to help make sure that NONE of our important campaign priorities get cut (and so I can surprise John with how many folks stepped up to help our campaign)?_**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220712-2?refcode=em20220712-6500&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6500_434096_5eVEwp&akid=6500%2E434096%2E5eVEwp)
We need to invest in all of this important work this month and next in order to flip this Senate seat, so thank you very much for your help!
Andrea

National Finance Director
Fetterman for PA

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220712-6500-footer&t=1&refcode2=6500_434096_5eVEwp&akid=6500%2E434096%2E5eVEwp)**

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

Last week, a member of Team Booker went to Twitter to find out what’s
pissing Kentuckians off, and what you want Charles to take action on.
Here’s some of the answers you gave:

“We’re 45th in education. Why?! WHY?! That’s it. That’s my biggest peeve.”

“Something that is more easily changed on a local level - good internet.
We are DESPERATE out here.
But also, healthcare, childcare, food inflation, climate crisis, all of
the above.”

“I have two gripes in two words, McConnell / Paul.”

“We need to be as bold as the GOP. Stack the court, blow up the
filibuster, make DC and PR states, codify voting protections. Then go for
EVERYTHING else. They would. They are.”

“Abortion abortion abortion. My daughter and your daughters and 10000s of
others have fewer rights than I did. Make it a priority (I know you
will).”

“I'm in Western Kentucky, there is a shortage of affordable housing and
childcare.”

“Rand Paul!!”

Peter, we’re so
grateful for everyone who shared what they want to change in our
Commonwealth.

Unlike Rand Paul, Charles Booker is listening and he’s ready to fight for
all Kentuckians, from the Hood to the Holler. But it’s up to us to make
sure he can beat Rand Paul and usher in the era of change we need in the
Commonwealth. We know that we can win by lifting up the voices that get
ignored and turning out voters who have felt left behind.

Paul? We need the resources to ensure we can take on Rand Paul’s corporate
warchest and grow a grassroots movement here in Kentucky to elect Charles
Booker.

Rand Paul and Mitch McConnell have become wealthy exploiting partisan
divides, while our state is one of the poorest in the country.

Enough is enough. We deserve life. We deserve freedom. We deserve
prosperity. We will win this fight.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220712.HtH-Qu&refcode=em20220712-2214&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=2214%2E346206%2EvMfR04 ]Peter, we
can win this race and build a new Kentucky that works for everyone, but we
need your help. Will you donate $5 to support Charles
Booker’s transformational campaign today?

Together, we’ll bring change to the Commonwealth.

Team Booker

Peter, Over the past three years, **we have been called to make choices and answer questions we did not expect.**

Questions about how, in a world that seemed frightening and different, we were going to raise our kids, continue to put food on the table, and care for our communities?

And questions that feel further out now like, how does our government interact with its citizenry in a time of crisis?

How is our government — one of the people, by the people, for the people — meant to protect life, but not stifle liberty?

_In crisis, do we foster freedom? Or do we force our citizens down?_

Well, over the past three years I believe we have had the truth revealed about those two vastly different approaches. Not in an academic textbook or in a theoretical debate, but in the harsh reality of governing during COVID. You could not find two more starkly different examples than the free state of Florida and the woke tyranny of Gavin Newsom’s California.

It isn't hard to understand why the Governor of California wants to talk about Florida. It's part of the one topic he tries to focus on: _**Anything but California.**_

Let's take a look at the record of the “liberal elite” in California:
1. They locked their kids out of public schools at the behest of the teachers’ unions.
2. They forced small businesses to close with many never to re-open again.
3. They hobbled law enforcement and allowed drugs and crime to destroy their cities.

Everything on that list is a tragedy, and it’s only made worse by the disregard and disrespect shown by leaders like Gavin Newsom. The idea of locking down your citizens and then darting off to the fanciest restaurant in the state to rub their noses in it.

It's wrong, it’s disgusting, and it's no surprise that every day driving around Florida I see more and more California license plates as a result.

**In Florida, we didn't bludgeon our people with government mandates; we lifted people up — protecting their jobs, their businesses, and their kids’ education.**
**[Help us keep Florida free in November>>>](https://secure.winred.com/rondesantis/imge-data-ccc-rvs/ "Help us keep Florida free in November>>>")**
We didn't lock business owners out of their livelihoods and we didn't lock people out of their jobs.

**In Florida we didn't turn a blind eye to crime and drugs, we put criminals behind bars, and we kept our streets safe.**

Gavin Newsom doesn't want to talk about California, and I don't blame him. But the reality is, there are plenty of woke liberal billionaires on Gavin Newsom’s speed dial who do not want to see individual freedom succeed. **_They don't want to see it succeed in Florida or anywhere else._**

Because if it succeeds, it shows everyone that the top down nanny-state tyranny of California is avoidable — Free people making their own decisions are better off than a locked down citizenry dictated to by elitists.

That's why I need your help. Gavin Newsom, funded by Hollywood liberals, Big Tech billionaires, and who knows who else is running ads in Florida. _**I need your help to fight back.**_ **On our side are free people who care to stay that way. On their side is everyone who thinks they know better.**

**Show them that we intend to stay free: [Make a donation right now](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8dff5ef65ff5434091ee3815f4d5cb9e&_e=HzFzr22tA0BLbhXROHy7Ab83b6Ws7mF20w7acnrnzX3pFwnIRw3syw91Vq9bjlVVIirJId7E_8ZvQjsfjnBq6ZrZt_a2eRuH7PssLgi5ztpKlTo7Z6GZHZoDd-Y5ysoPRbwZ_AcLHSulv_uC_t4QuzNgPmstU1L8koZYfV7m56K2Lkki_bPpC0h0qaza4peb2s_PrKIm4qaXoOj5mu5-Tu3DfTfxVnZ6V3moj0xVibTot75S-N2_wZNMT8vCMGP5p0eSOV19GB74s3vJo-rO8SeM5P9ib8KQjG7QtMXPi7iiOyBPks71teda7TqXKZlHMArkLOj6_goTfDo6_gEumcZQDomXgAvSwFm2Gndi6-mciNMcagFZr57ohLws6Xrp4T2MQm7-49CmmRz6P3EFGXPCD3SXfAWaBcb8vpjOBmc%3D "Make a donation right now") to help us fight back. body:
[1]Beto O'Rourke

Did you see yesterday’s big announcement?

Starting one week from today, Beto will travel more than 5,600 miles to
visit every part of the state this summer and hold 70 public events as he
campaigns to become the 49th governor of Texas.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220712-2.d5R6lk&refcode=ema20220712-198096&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=198096%2E444211%2EJsRjBn ]We need your help to pull it off. We’re almost halfway to our $300,000
goal to fund Beto’s 49-day Drive for Texas, and we’re counting on
grassroots donors to put us over the top. Will you pitch in
$3 or any amount you can spare today?

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220712-2.d5R6lk&refcode=ema20220712-198096&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=198096%2E444211%2EJsRjBn ]Donate to Support Beto’s Drive for Texas »

Below is yesterday’s announcement email if you want to learn more. Thank
you for helping us stay on the road!

—Beto for Texas

----Forwarded Email----
Subject: Today’s big announcement
Date: Monday, July 11, 2022
Sender: Beto for Texas
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com

Will
you be a part of the next chapter of Beto's campaign?

Today, Beto is announcing a Drive for Texas that will take our grassroots
campaign back to every part of the state. Here's the plan:

49 days. 5,600+ miles. 70+ events. 65+ counties. 75+ communities.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220712-2.d5R6lk&refcode=ema20220712-198096&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=198096%2E444211%2EJsRjBn ][IMG]

With the polls narrowing and Greg Abbott's favorability hitting historic
lows, it's time to do everything we can to bring Beto's positive, unifying
message to small towns and big cities across the state — but we need the
financial resources to fund our travel and reach every voter possible.

We've set a goal to raise $300,000 to ensure we have the resources to keep
Beto on the road, reserve campaign venues, host events, and reach voters —
but we'll need the support of this entire grassroots team to hit this goal
in time.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220712-2.d5R6lk&refcode=ema20220712-198096&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=198096%2E444211%2EJsRjBn ]Can
we count on you to chip in to power our statewide Drive for Texas?
Reaching this goal will be critical to meeting thousands of new people,
spreading the word about our campaign for ALL Texans, and defeating
Abbott.

In 2018, Beto came closer to winning statewide than any Democrat in
decades by visiting each of the state's 254 counties and connecting with
voters in their communities.

Now, with a record 59% of Texans saying the state is heading in the wrong
direction under Abbott, we have the chance to make real progress on the
issues that are most important to Texans — but we have to meet this
moment.

There's only one way to win this race — by going everywhere and meeting
everyone. But bringing Texans together and holding Greg Abbott accountable
will only be possible with your support.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220712-2.d5R6lk&refcode=ema20220712-198096&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=198096%2E444211%2EJsRjBn ]Please, will you make your
first donation now to
fund this statewide travel and fund our campaign to elect Beto?

Thank you,

Beto for Texas

If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.betoorourke.com/unsubscribe/bft-unsubscribe/?t=1006&akid=198096%2E444211%2EJsRjBn

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Cori Bush needs our help
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Hi Peter, it's Rep.
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez.

I’m writing to you today because in just 3 weeks, Rep. Cori Bush will have
to face four, corporate-backed challengers in a competitive primary
election.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/111142?refcode=em20220712-24255&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=24255%2E1203867%2EVH90kl ]Will you chip in $3 right now to help Cori push back
against these attacks and overcome the dark money being flooded in this
race?

Since meeting Cori in 2017, when we were both first-time House candidates
running to take on establishment Democrats to today, Cori has always
inspired me. And I couldn't be more proud to work alongside her in
Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/111142?refcode=em20220712-24255&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=24255%2E1203867%2EVH90kl ]Alt text here

Cori is exactly the leader we need to represent St. Louis in Congress. As
a nurse, pastor, and single mom of two kids, she has always been involved
in her community. After the murder of Michael Brown in 2014 just minutes
from where she lived, Cori stepped up to serve her neighbors as a triage
nurse. When attacks on abortion rights started escalating, Cori began
sharing her own abortion story and has been leading the fight to pass
urgent reproductive health protections in our communities.

Together, we introduced the Green New Deal for Cities to federally fund a
Green New Deal in every community and stayed outside the Capitol for five
days demanding an extended eviction moratorium to keep people housed.
Districts like Cori's and mine disproportionately feel the impacts of
environmental racism, economic inequity, and police violence — that’s why
Cori and I understand what's at stake in our work.

Keeping Cori with me in Congress is absolutely critical to ensuring the
future of our progressive movement. Together, we will continue holding the
line to pass Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, abortion access
protections, and the anti-racist policies our communities need.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/111142?refcode=em20220712-24255&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=24255%2E1203867%2EVH90kl ]Will you chip in $3 today to keep Cori in Congress,
reach Team Cori's $50,000 fundraising goal, and power their re-election
campaign? Cori needs our help today to build the resources to defend
against any GOP attacks.

Last cycle, corporate GOP mega-donors and less-than-progressive primary
challengers spent millions attacking me. Fox News would dedicate entire
segments spewing racist, false, negative attacks at our campaign.

And now these same kinds of attacks are being launched on Cori’s campaign.
Her corporate-backed opponent has already invested $100,000 in TV attack
ads and outside groups are pouring in millions to make our progressive
movement look weak.

From personal experience, I know how important it is that we all show up
as a movement to support Cori through this election. We must send a loud
message that we will not back down in our mission to dismantle systemic
racism in America and pass transformative policies that lift ALL of our
families up.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/111142?refcode=em20220712-24255&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=24255%2E1203867%2EVH90kl ]Cori's campaign set a goal to raise $50,000 in grassroots donations
before the final pre-primary FEC deadline on Wednesday to organize across
Missouri’s First District and reach out to voters before the election. If
you can, please donate any amount today to keep my sister, Cori Bush, in
Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/111142?refcode=em20220712-24255&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=24255%2E1203867%2EVH90kl ]Contribute $3

Pa’lante,

Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1024&akid=24255%2E1203867%2EVH90kl ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1025&akid=24255%2E1203867%2EVH90kl ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20220712-24255-footer&t=1026&refcode2=24255_1203867_VH90kl&akid=24255%2E1203867%2EVH90kl

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1027&akid=24255%2E1203867%2EVH90kl

Hi Friend,
Summer greetings to my friends and fellow patriots!

I am writing today with an update and an opportunity next week. I intend for this email to catch us up and I’ll be communicating more frequently in the coming months!
**Personal**
Since the primaries, I have been doing what many of you have been doing: taking a breather and reconnecting with family and friends after a grueling state-wide race. I’ve been tending my tree farm, my chickens and pigs, my home repairs, and my neighbor’s hay field. I’ve been doing a little consulting in the education world.

**Campaign
**I can’t thank you enough for your support during my campaign for Oregon governor. I would NOT have placed as strongly as I did, nor had the wind in my sails to complete my race without YOU. Your support emotionally, spiritually, and financially helped me fulfill my commitment to God. We ran a clean and strong race and attracted the attention of the political establishment, which now knows that WE THE PEOPLE are a FORCE that won’t be stopped.

**Next Steps**
And TAKE COURAGE – I AM NOT STOPPING and I know you won’t either!

I have been closely tracking the pulse of Oregon’s (and the nation’s) political landscape. We all know that it is a serious time in our history, and we MUST remain engaged.

I have been prayerfully considering running again for high office in Oregon, in due time. I have been meeting with spiritual and political leaders. I’ve been considering offers of many kinds. I’ve neglected to “hitch my wagon” to many who would clamor for my endorsement, policies, and tribe; I want ONLY the right alignments with true conservatives and patriots who WILL take back our state. We cannot afford political “business as usual,” and I won’t be a part of that.

I have no immediate announcements, but I do request your prayer for discernment and wisdom, and for the right pathways to come to light in the right timing.

You will be the first to know when I am led to step up and represent YOU in an elected capacity.

**I am involved in and will be keeping you updated on key issues of national sovereignty, freedom, elections, Constitutional liberties, and more. **

clean_body: | | | | July 15 & 16 2022 Hi Friend, Summer greetings to my friends and fellow patriots! I am writing today with an update and an opportunity next week. I intend for this email to catch us up and I’ll be communicating more frequently in the coming months! Personal Since the primaries, I have been doing what many of you have been doing: taking a breather and reconnecting with family and friends after a grueling state-wide race. I’ve been tending my tree farm, my chickens and pigs, my home repairs, and my neighbor’s hay field. I’ve been doing a little consulting in the education world. Campaign I can’t thank you enough for your support during my campaign for Oregon governor. I would NOT have placed as strongly as I did, nor had the wind in my sails to complete my race without YOU. Your support emotionally, spiritually, and financially helped me fulfill my commitment to God. We ran a clean and strong race and attracted the attention of the political establishment, which now knows that WE THE PEOPLE are a FORCE that won’t be stopped. Next Steps And TAKE COURAGE – I AM NOT STOPPING and I know you won’t either! I have been closely tracking the pulse of Oregon’s (and the nation’s) political landscape. We all know that it is a serious time in our history, and we MUST remain engaged. I have been prayerfully considering running again for high office in Oregon, in due time. I have been meeting with spiritual and political leaders. I’ve been considering offers of many kinds. I’ve neglected to “hitch my wagon” to many who would clamor for my endorsement, policies, and tribe; I want ONLY the right alignments with true conservatives and patriots who WILL take back our state. We cannot afford political “business as usual,” and I won’t be a part of that. I have no immediate announcements, but I do request your prayer for discernment and wisdom, and for the right pathways to come to light in the right timing. You will be the first to know when I am led to step up and represent YOU in an elected capacity. I am involved in and will be keeping you updated on key issues of national sovereignty, freedom, elections, Constitutional liberties, and more. OPPORTUNITY NEXT WEEK I would like to invite you to attend an upcoming event NEXT WEEK where I will be speaking on a critical NATIONAL SOVEREIGNITY topic that affects all of us. Exposing America’s real and present danger with intentionally compromised borders and the insidious national security and human trafficking crisis. You’ll learn WHAT and WHO is coming across our southern border, how it impacts Oregon (that’s MY part!), and what YOU CAN DO ABOUT IT to take back our state and nation. This is a 3 event tour July 15-16: July 15- Deschutes County July 16 – Salem & Clackamas I’m honored to be among leading national voices in national security who are blowing the whistle: | | Tom Homan Former Acting ICE Director under Trump | Mark Finchem Fmr. | Ryan Kelley, Republican Candidate for Gubernatorial Governor, announced Jamie Swafford, former Ethnic Vice Chair of the Michigan Republican Party, as his Lieutenant Governor pick.
---
---
"Jamie is incredible," said Kelley. "She is a voice of freedom that has been traveling across our great state. She has been spreading the message of freedom, hope and prosperity. I am proud that she accepted my invitation. Let's win this!"
Jamie Swafford has a background in law enforcement.
Having completed the police academy, she also received a degree in Criminial justice.
Swafford became a voice of hope, as she and her husband traveled the state, working tirelessly to promote constitutional conservative candidates.
At many of these events, she got to speak with Kelley, and they soon realized that their America First/Michigan First priorities were in alignment, and that together, they could achieve great things for the people of Michigan.
"What an incredible honor to be considered for the position of Lieutenant Governor," Swafford said. Thank you Ryan, for your confidence in me. I will not let you down."

This Saturday, Donald Trump is coming back to Arizona. He knows how important this state is, and he knows how important our race is.
#

Friends -
In less than one week, Donald Trump is coming back to Arizona and we expect his hand-picked candidate will be right on stage with him. Trump knows how important this state is, and how important our race is.
That’s why at one of his previous rallies here, he said: “Taking America back begins with kicking Mark Kelly the hell out of the United States Senate.”
And the truth is, if we don’t have the resources we need to win this race, he might get his wish. Millions of dollars have already been spent trying to defeat us, and millions more are coming. If Trump can help flip this seat, he’ll be that much more likely to run in 2024. He might even win.
Sorry to put that thought in your head, but it’s true.
That’s why I need to know if you can make a $5 contribution before Trump arrives. Because when he does, a lot of people from the far right are going to start looking at this race. And after that, those same folks are going to start pouring money into Arizona to try to beat me.

Friend, ICYMI: June was an eventful month for redistricting and American democracy. Let’s talk about what has happened:
* On June 24, the Supreme Court overturned _Roe_ , reversing more than 50 years of precedent and federal protections for abortion rights. 61% of Americans believe abortion should be legal in all or most cases.
* On June 28, the Supreme Court ruled that Louisiana could continue to use a congressional map that a federal court had found to violate the VRA. Although a third of the population in Louisiana is Black, only one out of six districts will be majority Black.
* On June 30, the Supreme Court announced that it will hear _Moore v. Harper_ , a case in which the Republicans argue that state legislatures should have almost sole control over congressional redistricting. If the Republicans are to succeed, redistricting will be on the ballot **_this fall._**

There’s no easy way to put this -- June was a damning month for our democracy and the future of fair redistricting efforts. A court of unelected justices gutted reproductive rights, slashed fair congressional maps, and now moves to overhaul the entire redistricting process.

[**So often have we heard that our democracy is in jeopardy. But these Republican threats will not stop and neither will we. Can we count on you to support our efforts?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47750151/355513533/2008317901?refcode=20220712_AOTL_F_icymi_redlite&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImE2YTNlZWI0LTUzMDItZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=BXKDTxJGjF1QW2ldkOZK8yFBkLZytl9cZChmmiIyHoA=)

body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresshttps://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220712_2 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220712_2]
Team,
We wanted to make sure you saw the email Elissa sent earlier about our pre-primary deadline coming up at midnight tomorrow.
Campaigns are required by federal law to report the money they’ve raised before each primary election. Since we reported these numbers recently (on June 30th to be exact), all we are showing this time around is how much we’ve been able to raise over the last 13 days.
As we head into one of the top 10 most competitive races in the entire country, this tight window is a perfect opportunity to show what Team Slotkin is capable of – and that we are prepared for anything that comes our way.
Will you chip in before July 13th to show anyone looking to flip Elissa’s seat that they are in for a tough fight? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220712_2]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220712_2]
Team Slotkin
Team,
It’s hard to believe I’m already saying this – but we have less than a month to go until our August 2nd Michigan primary.
This year has really flown by: I’ve made the move to Lansing, hit the ground in the new 7th district, and just last week we launched our first campaign ad on TVs across the Lansing media market (you can check it out here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220712_2] if you haven’t seen it already).
I don’t have a primary challenger this time around, which means I’ll be focusing my attention for the next few weeks on continuing to build out our strong volunteer networks, registering people to vote, and continuing to meet voters in the new parts of my district. On the Republican side, my presumed opponent is trying to win against a well-funded write-in campaign. The GOP feels at least somewhat worried about it, because their Super PACs have spent nearly half a million dollars to make sure the party favorite wins.
Ahead of that August 2nd primary we have an important filing deadline coming up tomorrow, on July 13th. Before a primary election, campaigns are required to report how much they’ve raised since the end of their last quarter – in this case, June 30th. That means we have another opportunity to show my opponent what Team Slotkin can accomplish in just 13 days.
So, I’m asking if you’d consider making a contribution before that July 13th deadline – both to help me prepare for November AND to show the other side what they’re up against! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220712_2]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220712_2]
Elissa
